_vibe_session_metadata.summary: Model quality: 55.33/100 (142 warnings, 0 errors). 387 tables across 19 domains.

domains.name: fabrication
domains.description: Core wafer fabrication and processing domain governing all FAB operations including FEOL, MOL, and BEOL process steps. Owns wafer lot tracking, WIP management, process recipe execution, and fab line scheduling across CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, ion implantation, and EUV/DUV lithography operations. Authoritative source for wafer genealogy and lot disposition via MES integration.

products.name: fabrication_wafer_lot
products.description: Core master entity representing a wafer lot (batch of wafers) tracked through the FAB from wafer start to lot disposition. Authoritative source for lot identity, wafer count, lot type (production, engineering, qualification, MPW), process node, technology node, product code, priority class, WIP status, hold flags, and genealogy linkage. Sourced from Camstar MES and Applied Materials SmartFactory MES. SSOT for all WIP lot tracking across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL operations. Quality and metrology data for this lot is owned by the quality domain and referenced via cross-domain FK.
products.reference: Camstar MES Lot Master / SEMI E10

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wafer lot tracked through the FAB from wafer start to lot disposition. Primary key for all WIP lot tracking across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL operations.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process route (recipe sequence) assigned to this lot. Defines the complete sequence of operations from wafer start to completion.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.technology_node. Business justification: Wafer lot references a technology node; replace string column with FK to technology_node for normalization.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Required for Production Planning Report linking each wafer lot to the specific IC catalog item being manufactured.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Required for lot‑level cost and yield reporting per design project, enabling profitability analysis and project KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: add column inventory_wafer_lot_id (BIGINT) with FK to inventory.inventory_wafer_lot.inventory_wafer_lot_id - establish clear SSOT relationship where inventory owns lot tracking

attributes.name: parent_lot_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent lot from which this lot was split or derived. Null for original lots. Enables wafer genealogy tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot completed all FAB processing operations and was dispositioned. Null for lots still in WIP.

attributes.name: current_operation_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the current process operation (e.g., CVD_OXIDE_DEP, EUV_LITHO, CMP_POLISH). Provides human-readable context for lot location.

attributes.name: current_operation_number
attributes.description: Sequential operation step number in the process route where the lot is currently located. Used for tracking lot position in the manufacturing flow.

attributes.name: current_process_area
attributes.description: High-level FAB area classification where the lot is currently located: FEOL (front-end-of-line transistor formation), MOL (middle-of-line contacts), BEOL (back-end-of-line interconnect), metrology (inspection), or test (electrical probe).

attributes.name: cycle_time_days
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in days from wafer start to lot completion. Key performance metric for manufacturing efficiency and customer responsiveness.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the lot to meet customer delivery commitments. Used for scheduling and on-time-delivery tracking.

attributes.name: fab_facility_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the physical FAB facility where the lot is being processed. Supports multi-site operations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot is currently on hold and prevented from processing. True when lot is held for quality, engineering, or disposition review.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for lot hold (e.g., QUAL_FAIL, ENG_REVIEW, EQUIP_DOWN, MATL_ISSUE). Null when hold_flag is false.

attributes.name: hold_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot was placed on hold. Used to calculate hold duration and impact on cycle time. Null when lot is not on hold.

attributes.name: initial_wafer_count
attributes.description: Original number of wafers when the lot was started. Used to calculate yield loss and scrap rate during processing.

attributes.name: is_hot_lot
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is designated as a hot lot requiring expedited processing and priority resource allocation. True for urgent customer orders.

attributes.name: lot_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot record was first created in the MES system. May precede wafer start for planning purposes.

attributes.name: lot_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the completed lot: pass (released to next stage), fail (rejected), partial (some wafers pass), rework (reprocess), scrap (discard), or engineering_hold (pending review).

attributes.name: lot_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operators and engineers to record important observations, special handling instructions, or process deviations for this lot.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the wafer lot assigned by MES at wafer start. Used for tracking and traceability across all FAB operations and external communications.

attributes.name: lot_on_node
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.technology_node.technology_node_id — Every lot is manufactured on a specific technology node. This is fundamental for WIP classification and routing.

attributes.name: lot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wafer lot purpose: production (revenue-generating), engineering (process development), qualification (product validation), MPW (multi-project wafer shuttle), pilot (pre-production), or rework (reprocessed lot).

attributes.name: lot_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot record was last modified in the MES system. Tracks most recent status or attribute change.

attributes.name: mes_system_source
attributes.description: Identifies the source MES system that created and manages this lot record: Camstar MES, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, or other. Used for data lineage and system integration.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Forecasted completion date based on current WIP position, remaining operations, and standard cycle times. Updated dynamically as lot progresses.

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Scheduling priority assigned to the lot for FAB resource allocation. Hot and expedite lots receive preferential processing to meet urgent customer commitments.

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Technology node of the semiconductor process measured in nanometers (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm). Defines the minimum feature size and process complexity.

attributes.name: process_time_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative time in hours the lot has spent in active processing on equipment. Excludes queue and hold time. Used for capacity planning.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IC product being manufactured. Used for reporting and customer communications.

attributes.name: queue_time_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative time in hours the lot has spent waiting in queue between operations. Excludes active processing time. Used to identify bottlenecks.

attributes.name: rework_count
attributes.description: Number of times the lot has been reworked or reprocessed through specific operations. Tracks process stability and quality issues.

attributes.name: route_version
attributes.description: Version number of the process route. Tracks recipe changes and process improvements over time for traceability and yield analysis.

attributes.name: sampling_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the quality sampling and inspection plan applied to this lot. Defines which wafers are sampled and at which operations for metrology and defect inspection.

attributes.name: scrap_wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafers scrapped during processing due to defects, breakage, or sampling. Used to calculate yield loss and process capability.

attributes.name: split_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned when a lot is split into multiple child lots. Used with parent_lot_id to track lot genealogy and wafer provenance.

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Current number of wafers in the lot. May decrease due to scraps, breakage, or sampling during processing. Initial count typically 25 wafers per lot for standard production.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the silicon wafers in the lot measured in millimeters. Standard sizes include 200mm (8-inch) and 300mm (12-inch).

attributes.name: wafer_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer lot was officially started in the FAB and entered WIP tracking. Represents the beginning of the lot's manufacturing lifecycle.

attributes.name: wip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wafer lot in the FAB workflow. Tracks lot progression from queue through processing to final disposition.

products.name: wafer
products.description: Individual silicon wafer entity within a lot, tracking wafer number, substrate type, diameter, orientation, resistivity, epitaxial layer specs, and current disposition. Enables per-wafer genealogy and yield tracking across all FAB process steps. Sourced from Camstar MES wafer tracking module.
products.reference: Camstar MES Wafer Record / SEMI M1

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual silicon wafer within the fabrication facility. Primary key for wafer tracking across all FAB (Fabrication Facility) process steps.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who ordered this wafer fabrication. Relevant for foundry operations and MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) services.

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility where this wafer is being processed. Supports multi-site operations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process route or recipe that defines the sequence of fabrication steps for this wafer. Routes vary by product technology node and design.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.technology_node. Business justification: Wafer references a technology node; add FK to technology_node and remove numeric node column.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent wafer lot that this wafer belongs to. Wafers are processed in lots through the FAB (Fabrication Facility).

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Needed for Yield Analysis linking each wafer to its IC product for defect tracking.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC (Integrated Circuit) design project that this wafer is fabricating. Links to design specifications, GDS (Graphic Data System) files, and tapeout records.

attributes.name: mask_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the photomask set used for lithography steps on this wafer. Each mask set corresponds to a specific design and technology node.

attributes.name: belongs_to_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot.fabrication_wafer_lot_id — Every wafer must reference its parent lot. This is the most fundamental relationship in FAB WIP tracking - wafers are always tracked within the context of their lot.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the wafer completed all FAB (Fabrication Facility) process steps and is ready for wafer probing or shipment to OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test). Null for in-process wafers.

attributes.name: critical_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of critical defects that are likely to cause die failure. Subset of total defect count, used for yield prediction and SPC (Statistical Process Control).

attributes.name: crystal_orientation
attributes.description: Crystallographic orientation of the silicon wafer surface, specified using Miller indices. <100> is most common for CMOS (Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor) fabrication.

attributes.name: current_operation_number
attributes.description: Sequential operation number in the process route that the wafer is currently at. Used for tracking progress through the hundreds of steps in IC (Integrated Circuit) fabrication.

attributes.name: current_process_step
attributes.description: Name or code of the current fabrication process step the wafer is at or has completed. Examples: lithography, CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition), CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization), ion implantation.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects detected on the wafer surface through inspection systems. Tracked across process steps to monitor yield and process control.

attributes.name: diameter_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the wafer in millimeters. Standard sizes include 150mm (6 inch), 200mm (8 inch), and 300mm (12 inch). Larger diameters enable more dies per wafer.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the wafer in the FAB (Fabrication Facility) workflow. Tracks lifecycle state from WIP (Work in Process) through completion or scrap.

attributes.name: doping_type
attributes.description: Electrical doping type of the substrate. P-type (boron-doped) or N-type (phosphorus/arsenic-doped) determines the majority carrier type. Intrinsic wafers are undoped.

attributes.name: epitaxial_layer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wafer has an epitaxial layer grown on the substrate. Epitaxial wafers have a thin crystalline layer with controlled properties for advanced device fabrication.

attributes.name: epitaxial_resistivity_ohm_cm
attributes.description: Electrical resistivity of the epitaxial layer in ohm-centimeters, if present. Null for non-epitaxial wafers. Often differs from substrate resistivity.

attributes.name: epitaxial_thickness_um
attributes.description: Thickness of the epitaxial layer in micrometers, if present. Null for non-epitaxial wafers. Typical range: 1-20 micrometers.

attributes.name: expected_die_count
attributes.description: Expected number of dies (individual chips) on this wafer based on die size and wafer diameter. Used for yield calculation and planning.

attributes.name: genealogy_path
attributes.description: Hierarchical path tracking the wafer lineage from ingot to lot to wafer. Enables traceability for quality investigations and compliance. Format varies by MES (Manufacturing Execution System).

attributes.name: good_die_count
attributes.description: Actual number of dies that passed electrical testing and quality inspection. Populated after wafer probing and testing. Used to calculate wafer yield.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for wafer hold or quarantine, if applicable. Examples: out-of-spec measurement, equipment issue, quality investigation. Null for non-held wafers.

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent defect inspection or metrology measurement performed on this wafer. Null if no inspection has been performed yet.

attributes.name: last_process_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent process step or operation performed on this wafer. Used for WIP (Work in Process) tracking and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: notch_orientation_degrees
attributes.description: Angular position of the wafer notch in degrees, used for wafer alignment and orientation during automated processing. Standard is 0 degrees for <110> direction.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Processing priority level for this wafer. Critical and high priority wafers receive expedited processing to meet customer commitments or TTM (Time to Market) requirements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer record was first created in the data system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer record was last updated in the data system. Audit field for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: resistivity_ohm_cm
attributes.description: Electrical resistivity of the wafer substrate in ohm-centimeters. Indicates doping concentration and electrical properties. Typical range: 0.001 to 100+ ohm-cm.

attributes.name: rework_count
attributes.description: Number of times this wafer has been reworked or reprocessed due to process excursions or quality issues. Tracked for yield analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for wafer scrap, if applicable. Examples: excessive defects, process excursion, handling damage, contamination. Null for non-scrapped wafers.

attributes.name: slot_position
attributes.description: Physical slot position of the wafer within the carrier or cassette during processing. Used for tracking and automation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the wafer entered the FAB (Fabrication Facility) and began processing. Marks the beginning of the wafer lifecycle for cycle time tracking.

attributes.name: substrate_type
attributes.description: Material composition of the wafer substrate. Silicon is most common, but compound semiconductors like GaAs (Gallium Arsenide), SiC (Silicon Carbide), and GaN (Gallium Nitride) are used for specialized applications.

attributes.name: thickness_um
attributes.description: Thickness of the wafer in micrometers. Typical range is 500-800 micrometers depending on diameter and application. Critical for mechanical stability and process control.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the wafer within its lot. Typically a sequential number or alphanumeric code assigned during lot creation.

products.name: fabrication_process_recipe
products.description: Master record for a validated process recipe defining the exact sequence of process parameters, tool settings, gas flows, temperatures, pressures, and timing for a specific FAB operation (CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, implant, etch, lithography). Includes recipe version history, approval status, change control reference, qualification status, and effective date range. Versioning managed within this entity via version number and effective dates. Sourced from Applied Materials SmartFactory MES recipe management and integrated with engineering change order workflow.
products.reference: SmartFactory MES Recipe Master / SEMI E10

attributes.name: fabrication_process_recipe_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabrication process recipe. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: equipment_process_recipe_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the equipment process recipe record within the fabrication process recipe fabrication entity.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.pdk. Business justification: Recipe qualification and change‑control require explicit reference to the PDK version the recipe supports, ensuring process compatibility.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the recipe was formally approved for production use.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Engineering approval status indicating whether the recipe has been reviewed and authorized for use by process engineering and quality teams.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the process engineer or quality manager who approved this recipe for production use.

attributes.name: chamber_configuration
attributes.description: Specific chamber or module configuration within the equipment where the recipe is executed, enabling multi-chamber tool recipe management.

attributes.name: change_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Product Change Notification (PCN) that authorized the creation or modification of this recipe.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was first created in the MES system.

attributes.name: defect_density_target_per_cm2
attributes.description: Target defect density in defects per square centimeter for wafers processed with this recipe, critical for yield management.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this recipe version is superseded or retired. Null indicates the recipe is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this recipe version becomes effective and available for production use.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this recipe complies with environmental regulations including RoHS, REACH, and TSCA for chemical usage and emissions.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type or model of fabrication equipment (tool) for which this recipe is designed, such as Applied Materials Centura, Lam Research Flex, or ASML NXT scanner.

attributes.name: fmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) document that identifies potential failure modes and mitigation strategies for this recipe.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference

attributes.name: gas_flow_parameters
attributes.description: Detailed gas flow settings including gas types, flow rates (sccm), and ratios for CVD, PVD, ALD, and etch processes. Stored as structured text or JSON.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this recipe is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export control restrictions.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was last modified, supporting change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: power_settings_watts
attributes.description: RF or DC power settings in watts for plasma-based processes such as PVD, etch, and plasma-enhanced CVD.

attributes.name: process_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration in seconds for the recipe execution from start to completion.

attributes.name: process_layer_type
attributes.description: Fabrication layer classification: Front End of Line (FEOL) for transistor formation, Middle of Line (MOL) for contacts, or Back End of Line (BEOL) for interconnects.

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Technology node in nanometers for which this recipe is designed (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm), indicating the target feature size.

attributes.name: process_operation_type
attributes.description: Type of FAB operation this recipe defines: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD), Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP), etch, lithography (EUV/DUV), ion implantation, diffusion, oxidation, annealing, or cleaning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CVD|PVD|ALD|CMP|etch|lithography|ion_implantation|diffusion|oxidation|annealing|cleaning — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: process_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Target chamber pressure in Torr for the recipe execution, critical for CVD, PVD, and ALD processes.

attributes.name: process_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target process temperature in degrees Celsius for the recipe execution.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Product family or IC design family for which this recipe is optimized (e.g., mobile processors, automotive chips, AI accelerators).

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the recipe successfully completed qualification testing and was certified for production.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Qualification state indicating whether the recipe has passed validation testing and is certified for production use.

attributes.name: recipe_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the recipe for system identification and traceability across MES and ERP systems.

attributes.name: recipe_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the recipes purpose, process objectives, and special considerations for operators and engineers.

attributes.name: recipe_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the process recipe used for identification and reference by FAB operators and process engineers.

attributes.name: recipe_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recipe: draft (under development), under_review (pending approval), approved (validated but not yet active), active (in production use), suspended (temporarily disabled), or obsolete (retired).

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the recipe enabling change control and traceability of recipe evolution over time.

attributes.name: requalification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the recipe must be requalified to remain in active production status, per quality management requirements.

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Safety classification indicating special handling requirements: standard, hazardous_material, high_temperature, high_pressure, or toxic_gas.

attributes.name: spc_control_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Statistical Process Control (SPC) plan that monitors this recipes performance and detects process drift.

tag_set.value: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Reference

attributes.name: step_sequence_definition
attributes.description: Ordered sequence of process steps within the recipe, including step names, durations, and parameter transitions. Stored as structured text or JSON.

attributes.name: target_material
attributes.description: Material being deposited, etched, or processed by this recipe (e.g., silicon dioxide, tungsten, copper, photoresist, low-k dielectric).

attributes.name: target_thickness_nm
attributes.description: Target thickness in nanometers for deposition or remaining thickness after etch/CMP operations.

attributes.name: uniformity_target_percent
attributes.description: Target uniformity percentage for thickness, composition, or other critical parameters across the wafer surface.

attributes.name: yield_target_percent
attributes.description: Target yield percentage for wafers processed using this recipe, used for performance monitoring and continuous improvement.

products.name: fabrication_process_step
products.description: Individual process step definition within a process flow routing, specifying step sequence number, operation type (FEOL/MOL/BEOL), process category (lithography, etch, deposition, CMP, implant, anneal, clean, wet clean), target recipe reference, equipment class constraint, SPC control plan linkage, rework loop indicators, and step-level cycle time targets. Forms the authoritative step catalog for all FAB routing and is the granular unit of WIP tracking. Aligned with SEMI E40 process management standard for step-level definition.
products.reference: MES Process Step / SEMI E10 Process Flow

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process step within the FAB routing. Primary key for the process step entity.

attributes.name: equipment_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment group or tool set qualified to run this process step. Enables flexible dispatching across multiple qualified tools.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent process flow routing that contains this step. Links the step to its overall manufacturing route.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the target process recipe that defines the detailed parameters, settings, and control logic for executing this step on the equipment.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Process Step Ownership tracking; accountability and engineering reports need the responsible engineer's employee ID.

attributes.name: rework_target_step_fk
attributes.description: Reference to the target process step to which lots are routed when rework is triggered from this step. Null if no rework loop exists.

attributes.name: spc_control_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Linkage to the SPC control plan governing this step. Defines control charts, control limits, sampling rules, and out-of-control response actions.

tag_set.value: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Identifier (ID)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the process step was approved for production use. Used for change control and audit trails.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the process step definition. Tracks engineering change control and qualification approval.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer or manager who approved this process step for production use. Used for traceability and accountability.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Number of wafers or lots that can be processed together in a single batch at this step. Null for single-wafer processing steps.

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Engineering change order or change control number associated with the creation or modification of this process step. Links to formal change management process.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center to which this process step is allocated for cost accounting and budgeting purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process step record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_step_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this step is critical to product quality or yield. Critical steps require enhanced monitoring, control, and approval workflows.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this process step definition is retired or superseded. Null for currently active steps. Supports historical tracking and version control.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this process step definition becomes effective and can be used in production routing. Supports time-based version control.

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: Constraint specifying the class or type of equipment required to execute this process step. Used by MES for equipment qualification and dispatching.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether inline inspection or metrology is required after this step. True if inspection is mandatory before proceeding to the next step.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this process step record. Used for accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process step record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: max_queue_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum allowable queue time in minutes before the step must be processed or the lot is flagged for hold. Critical for time-sensitive processes.

attributes.name: min_batch_size
attributes.description: Minimum number of wafers or lots required to start processing at this step. Used for batch tool optimization and scheduling.

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operation Type (Front End of Line / Middle of Line / Back End of Line)
attributes.description: High-level classification of the process step into Front End of Line (FEOL), Middle of Line (MOL), or Back End of Line (BEOL) manufacturing phases.

tag_set.value: Operation Type (Front End of Line / Middle of Line / Back End of Line)

attributes.name: process_category
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the process step by operation category such as lithography, etch, deposition (CVD/PVD/ALD), Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP), ion implant, thermal anneal, clean, wet clean, inspection, or metrology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lithography|etch|deposition|CMP|implant|anneal|clean|wet_clean|inspection|metrology — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: process_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular subcategory within the process category, such as EUV lithography, DUV lithography, plasma etch, reactive ion etch, CVD, PVD, ALD, etc. Provides detailed process technology classification.

attributes.name: rework_loop_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this step is part of a rework loop. True if the step can route back to an earlier step for defect correction or reprocessing.

attributes.name: sampling_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of lots or wafers that must be sampled for inspection or metrology at this step. Used for statistical quality control.

attributes.name: skip_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this step can be skipped under certain conditions (e.g., engineering wafers, test lots). True if skip is permitted.

attributes.name: standard_queue_time_minutes
attributes.description: Expected queue time in minutes before the step begins processing. Used for scheduling and WIP prediction.

attributes.name: step_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the step type across all FAB operations. Used for cross-facility consistency and reporting.

attributes.name: step_cost_per_wafer
attributes.description: Standard cost per wafer for executing this process step. Used for product costing, yield analysis, and financial planning. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: step_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the process step, including purpose, key parameters, and special handling instructions for operators and engineers.

attributes.name: step_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for the process step. Used for operator reference and MES display.

attributes.name: step_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this step within the process flow routing. Determines the execution order of operations in the FAB.

attributes.name: step_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the process step definition. Active steps are in production use; inactive or obsolete steps are retired; engineering steps are under development; pending approval steps await qualification.

attributes.name: target_cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Step-level target cycle time in minutes. Used for capacity planning, scheduling, and WIP flow optimization.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the process step definition. Incremented with each engineering change. Supports change control and traceability.

products.name: fabrication_process_flow
products.description: Ordered sequence of process steps defining the complete manufacturing route for a product on a given technology node. Captures flow revision, node generation (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm), flow type (standard, MPW, engineering), effective dates, and approval status. SSOT for FAB routing and WIP scheduling. Aligned with SEMI E40 process management standard for flow-level routing definition.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process flow. Primary key for the process flow entity.

attributes.name: cooling_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier for cooling process flow id on the fabrication process flow record.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Process Design Kit (PDK) that provides device models, design rules, and technology files for this process flow.

attributes.name: process_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Process Flow Owner is an employee; ownership reports and change‑control need the employee ID.

attributes.name: rule_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design rule set (DRC/LVS rules) that physical layouts must comply with for this process flow.

attributes.name: spc_control_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Reference to the Statistical Process Control (SPC) plan governing in-line monitoring and process control for this flow.

tag_set.value: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Identifier (ID)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this process flow received formal approval for use in FAB operations.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the process engineer or manager who approved this process flow for production use.

attributes.name: beol_step_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Back End Of Line (BEOL) Step Count
attributes.description: Number of process steps in the Back End Of Line (BEOL) phase covering metal interconnect layers and passivation.

tag_set.value: Back End Of Line (BEOL) Step Count

attributes.name: cool_optimization_mode
attributes.description: The cool optimization mode of the fabrication process flow record in the fabrication domain.

attributes.name: coolant_type
attributes.description: The coolant type for the fabrication process flow record.

attributes.name: cooling_method
attributes.description: The cooling method for fabrication process flow.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_mode
attributes.description: The cooling optimization mode of the fabrication process flow record in the fabrication domain.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process flow record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the process flow including its purpose, key characteristics, and intended applications.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this process flow is no longer valid for new wafer lot starts. Nullable for flows with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this process flow becomes valid and available for wafer lot routing and WIP scheduling.

attributes.name: environmental_classification
attributes.description: Environmental and chemical safety classification for materials and processes used in this flow (e.g., RoHS compliant, REACH registered).

attributes.name: estimated_cycle_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated total manufacturing cycle time in days for a wafer lot to complete this entire process flow under normal conditions.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification number (ECCN) or ITAR designation governing international transfer and use of this process technology.

attributes.name: fab_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the FAB facility or fabrication site where this process flow is executed.

attributes.name: feol_step_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Front End Of Line (FEOL) Step Count
attributes.description: Number of process steps in the Front End Of Line (FEOL) phase covering transistor formation and active device fabrication.

tag_set.value: Front End Of Line (FEOL) Step Count

attributes.name: flow_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the process flow used across FAB operations and MES systems.

attributes.name: flow_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the process flow identifying the manufacturing route.

attributes.name: flow_revision
attributes.description: Revision identifier tracking version changes to the process flow definition.

attributes.name: flow_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the process flow indicating its approval and usage state in FAB operations.

attributes.name: flow_type
attributes.description: Classification of the process flow indicating its purpose: standard production, Multi-Project Wafer (MPW), engineering evaluation, qualification, or research and development (R&D).

attributes.name: is_customer_specific
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this process flow is customized for a specific customer or represents a standard foundry offering.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this process flow record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process flow record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lithography_technology
attributes.description: Primary lithography technology used in critical patterning steps: EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet), DUV (Deep Ultraviolet), immersion, or dry lithography.

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers defined in the BEOL portion of this process flow.

attributes.name: mol_step_count
attributes.description: Number of process steps in the Middle Of Line (MOL) phase covering contact formation and local interconnect.

attributes.name: qualification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the process flow successfully completed qualification testing and was certified for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Status of the process flow qualification indicating whether it has passed reliability and performance validation testing.

attributes.name: requires_nre
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this process flow requires Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) investment for setup and qualification.

attributes.name: substrate_type
attributes.description: Type of substrate material used in this process flow (e.g., silicon, silicon-on-insulator, gallium arsenide, silicon carbide).

attributes.name: target_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target yield percentage (good dies per wafer) expected for wafer lots processed through this flow. Business-sensitive manufacturing performance metric.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor process technology node generation defining the minimum feature size and manufacturing capability (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 3nm|5nm|7nm|10nm|14nm|16nm|22nm|28nm|40nm|65nm|90nm|130nm|180nm — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_process_steps
attributes.description: Total number of discrete process steps defined in this flow spanning FEOL, MOL, and BEOL operations.

attributes.name: transistor_architecture
attributes.description: Transistor device architecture employed in this process flow: planar MOSFET, FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor), GAA (Gate All Around), or nanosheet.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Wafer diameter in millimeters that this process flow is designed for (e.g., 200mm, 300mm, 450mm).

attributes.name: waste_elimination_strategy
attributes.description: The waste elimination strategy of the fabrication process flow record in the fabrication domain.

attributes.name: waste_elimination_target_pct
attributes.description: The waste elimination target pct of the fabrication process flow record in the fabrication domain.

products.name: lot_move
products.description: Transactional record of each WIP lot movement through a process step in the FAB, capturing move-in timestamp, move-out timestamp, operator ID, equipment used, recipe executed, actual process parameters, pass/fail disposition, and quantity in/out. Core MES transaction sourced from Camstar MES and SmartFactory MES. Enables cycle time analysis and WIP genealogy.
products.reference: Camstar MES Move Transaction / SEMI E10

attributes.name: lot_move_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot move transaction. Primary key for this WIP (Work in Process) lot movement event through a FAB (Fabrication Facility) process step.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Internal cost tracking of lot movements charges labor and handling to the appropriate cost center.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the FAB (Fabrication Facility) operator or technician who executed or supervised this lot move. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: equipment_run_id
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.equipment_run.equipment_run_id — Each lot move through a process step is executed via an equipment run. Links WIP tracking to process execution for traceability.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the FAB (Fabrication Facility) equipment or tool used to process this lot move (e.g., ATE (Automatic Test Equipment), lithography stepper, etcher, deposition chamber). Links to equipment master data.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the IC (Integrated Circuit) product or device being manufactured in this lot. Links to product master data (e.g., SoC (System on Chip), ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit), FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array)).

attributes.name: operation_process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Lot move corresponds to a specific process step; linking supports operation tracking and step‑level performance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the WIP (Work in Process) lot being moved. References the wafer lot entity tracked through the FAB (Fabrication Facility).

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the process recipe executed during this lot move. Defines the specific parameter set, process conditions, and control settings used for this operation.

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific process chamber or module within the equipment used for this lot move. Relevant for multi-chamber tools (e.g., CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition), PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition), ALD (Atomic Layer Deposition) systems).

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the manufacturing work order or production order associated with this lot move. Links to ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) or MES (Manufacturing Execution System) work order master data.

attributes.name: actual_flow_rate_sccm
attributes.description: Actual gas flow rate in SCCM (Standard Cubic Centimeters per Minute) for process gases during this lot move. Critical parameter for deposition and etch processes.

attributes.name: actual_power_watts
attributes.description: Actual RF (Radio Frequency) or DC power in watts applied during this lot move. Critical parameter for plasma processes (etch, PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition), PECVD (Plasma-Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition)).

attributes.name: actual_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Actual process chamber pressure in Torr recorded during this lot move. Critical parameter for vacuum processes (PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition), CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition), etch, implant).

attributes.name: actual_temperature_c
attributes.description: Actual process temperature in degrees Celsius recorded during this lot move. Critical parameter for thermal processes (CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition), diffusion, anneal, oxidation).

attributes.name: at_step
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.process_step.process_step_id — Every lot move occurs at a specific process step. This links the transaction to the routing position.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the operator or engineer regarding this lot move. Captures contextual information, issues, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: control_job_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) control job that orchestrated this lot move. Links to the higher-level job or batch execution context in Camstar MES or SmartFactory MES.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lot move record was first created in the source system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects detected during or after this lot move, as reported by inline inspection or metrology systems. Used for yield analysis and SPC (Statistical Process Control).

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Quality disposition or pass/fail outcome of the lot move. Determines whether the lot proceeds to the next step, requires rework, is scrapped, or is placed on hold for further inspection.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for a lot hold, if applicable (e.g., quality issue, equipment failure, engineering review, customer request). Empty if lot is not on hold.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lot move record was last updated in the source system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measurement_value field (e.g., nm (nanometers), um (micrometers), angstrom, ohm-cm (resistivity), percent, ppm (parts per million)).

attributes.name: measurement_value
attributes.description: Primary metrology measurement value captured during this lot move (e.g., film thickness, CD (Critical Dimension), overlay, resistivity). Unit of measure is context-dependent on the operation type.

attributes.name: move_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lot was moved into the process step or equipment. Marks the start of processing for this operation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: move_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lot was moved out of the process step or equipment. Marks the completion of processing for this operation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: move_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lot move transaction. Indicates whether the move completed successfully, is still in progress, was aborted, held for review, or skipped.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Scheduling priority level for this lot move. Hot and expedite lots receive preferential processing to meet urgent customer commitments or TTM (Time to Market) targets.

attributes.name: process_layer
attributes.description: Manufacturing layer classification for this process step. FEOL (Front End of Line) covers transistor formation, MOL (Middle of Line) covers contacts, BEOL (Back End of Line) covers interconnects and metallization.

attributes.name: process_module
attributes.description: High-level process module category for this operation (e.g., lithography, etch, deposition, ion implantation, CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization), diffusion, metrology, inspection, test). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lithography|etch|deposition|implant|CMP|diffusion|metrology|inspection|test — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: process_time_seconds
attributes.description: Actual processing time in seconds for this lot move, calculated as the duration between move-in and move-out timestamps. Used for cycle time analysis and equipment utilization tracking.

attributes.name: quantity_in
attributes.description: Number of wafers or units in the lot at move-in. Represents the starting quantity before processing.

attributes.name: quantity_out
attributes.description: Number of wafers or units in the lot at move-out. Represents the ending quantity after processing. May differ from quantity_in due to scrap, breakage, or sampling.

attributes.name: queue_time_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds the lot spent waiting in queue before move-in. Measures WIP (Work in Process) wait time and identifies bottlenecks in the FAB (Fabrication Facility) flow.

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version number of the process recipe executed. Tracks recipe revisions and enables traceability for process changes and yield analysis.

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lot move is a rework operation (True) or a first-pass operation (False). Rework lots are reprocessed due to defects or out-of-spec conditions.

attributes.name: sampling_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether wafers were sampled from this lot during this move (True) for destructive testing, metrology, or inspection. False if no sampling occurred.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Number of wafers or units scrapped during this lot move due to breakage, defects, or process failures. Used for yield loss tracking and DPPM (Defective Parts Per Million) calculation.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Process technology node for this lot (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 14nm, 28nm, 180nm). Defines the minimum feature size and process generation.

attributes.name: tracks_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Every lot move transaction must reference the lot being moved. Core MES transaction integrity — cannot track WIP without this FK.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the wafers in this lot in millimeters (e.g., 200mm, 300mm, 450mm). Standard wafer size for the FAB (Fabrication Facility).

products.name: wafer_start
products.description: Transactional record authorizing and recording the initiation of a new wafer lot into the FAB line, capturing wafer start date, authorized quantity, product code, technology node, priority class, customer order reference, and wafer start type (production, engineering, qualification, MPW). SSOT for FAB capacity consumption and WIP entry.
products.reference: MES Wafer Start / SAP PP Production Order

attributes.name: wafer_start_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wafer start transaction. Primary key for the wafer start record.

attributes.name: fabrication_photomask_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the photomask set (reticle set) used for lithography steps in this wafer lot. Links to the physical layout and GDS data.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the manufacturing process flow (recipe sequence) that this wafer lot will follow. Defines the FEOL, MOL, and BEOL steps.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Supports Wafer Start Scheduling report tying start orders to the IC catalog entry.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Needed for Wafer Start Material Certification process, tying each wafer start to the supplied material master record for quality and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the MPW shuttle run if this wafer start combines multiple customer designs on shared wafers. Null for dedicated production lots.

attributes.name: primary_wafer_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the production planner or manufacturing engineer who authorized this wafer start. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Project‑level production scheduling and cost allocation depend on associating each wafer start order with the research project that requested it.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: Required for Wafer Start Planning report linking each wafer start to its originating sales order, enabling traceability from order to production schedule.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer start was formally authorized in the MES system. Precedes the actual release to the FAB line.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this wafer start record was first created in the MES database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: creates_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Wafer start transaction creates a new lot. Required for lot lifecycle tracking from inception.

attributes.name: crystal_orientation
attributes.description: Crystallographic orientation of the silicon wafer, expressed in Miller indices (e.g., <100>, <111>). Affects electrical properties and process compatibility.

attributes.name: doping_type
attributes.description: Electrical doping type of the starting wafer substrate: p-type (boron-doped), n-type (phosphorus or arsenic-doped), or intrinsic (undoped).

attributes.name: ear_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) under EAR for this product. Format: 5-character code (e.g., 3A001). Null if not export-controlled.

attributes.name: estimated_cycle_time_days
attributes.description: Planned total cycle time from wafer start to completion, measured in days. Based on standard process flow duration and current FAB loading.

attributes.name: fab_facility_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the fabrication facility where this wafer lot is being processed. Used for multi-site capacity planning and yield tracking.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for placing this wafer start on hold, if applicable. Examples: quality issue, material shortage, engineering review, customer request.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this wafer lot contains ITAR-controlled technology requiring export compliance controls. True if ITAR applies; False otherwise.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this wafer start record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot identifier assigned to the wafer batch at start. This is the primary tracking identifier throughout FAB operations.

attributes.name: nre_project_code
attributes.description: Reference to the NRE project if this wafer start is part of a customer-funded development program. Used for cost tracking and milestone billing.

attributes.name: parent_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the parent lot if this wafer start is a split or rework from an existing lot. Null for original starts. Enables wafer genealogy tracking.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date for completing all FAB processing steps and releasing the lot to wafer test. Based on standard cycle time for the process flow.

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Scheduling priority for this wafer lot in the FAB line. Hot lots receive expedited processing; engineering lots may have flexible timing; standard and low follow normal queue discipline.

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: Specific production line or bay within the FAB facility assigned to this wafer start. Determines equipment set and process capability.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer lot was physically released into the FAB line and began processing. Marks the start of cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested delivery date for finished wafers or packaged units. Drives priority and scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: resistivity_ohm_cm
attributes.description: Electrical resistivity of the starting wafer substrate, measured in ohm-centimeters. Indicates doping concentration and electrical characteristics.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any special handling instructions, process deviations, or notes that operators and engineers should be aware of for this wafer lot.

attributes.name: split_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this lot was split from a parent lot, if applicable. Examples: process experiment, capacity balancing, quality segregation.

attributes.name: start_creates_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot.fabrication_wafer_lot_id — Wafer start transactions create/authorize new lots. This links lot creation to the lot master.

attributes.name: substrate_type
attributes.description: Type of semiconductor substrate material used for this wafer lot. Silicon is standard; SOI (Silicon on Insulator), GaAs (Gallium Arsenide), GaN (Gallium Nitride), and SiC (Silicon Carbide) are specialty materials.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Process technology node for this wafer start, expressed in nanometers (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm). Determines the process recipe and equipment set.

attributes.name: wafer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of wafers authorized and started in this lot. Represents the initial wafer count at FAB entry before any processing losses.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the silicon wafer in millimeters. Standard values are 200mm or 300mm. Determines compatible equipment and process chambers.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the wafer lot was authorized and initiated into the FAB line. Principal business event timestamp for capacity planning and WIP tracking.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the wafer start transaction, externally visible and used for tracking and reporting. Format: WS followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wafer start transaction. Authorized: approved but not yet released; Released: entered FAB line; In Process: active WIP; Completed: all steps finished; Cancelled: terminated before completion; On Hold: temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the wafer lot was released into the FAB line, including time zone. Used for detailed cycle time analysis and shift-level tracking.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the wafer start purpose: production (customer orders), engineering (process development), qualification (product validation), MPW (multi-project wafer), pilot (pre-production), or rework (reprocessing).

attributes.name: work_center
attributes.description: SAP work center code representing the initial processing area for this wafer start. Used for capacity planning and cost allocation.

products.name: fabrication_lot_hold
products.description: Transactional record capturing all hold events placed on a wafer lot, including hold reason code, hold type (engineering, quality, process excursion, customer), initiating system or operator, hold placement timestamp, release timestamp, and disposition action taken. Enables hold cycle time tracking and excursion management.

attributes.name: fabrication_lot_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabrication lot hold event record.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom the lot is being fabricated, relevant for customer-initiated holds or customer notification.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who approved the hold release.

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility where the hold event occurred.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment unit associated with the hold event, if applicable (e.g., tool that triggered the excursion).

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step (FEOL, MOL, BEOL operation) where the lot was held.

attributes.name: inventory_lot_hold_id
attributes.description: add column inventory_lot_hold_id (BIGINT) with FK to inventory.inventory_lot_hold.inventory_lot_hold_id - establish clear SSOT relationship where inventory owns hold records

attributes.name: primary_fabrication_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or operator identifier who placed the hold on the lot.

attributes.name: primary_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot that is placed on hold.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (IC design, SoC, ASIC) being fabricated in the lot under hold.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicator whether management or engineering approval is required before the hold can be released.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold release was approved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hold record was first created in the data system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicator whether the customer must be notified of this hold event per contractual or quality agreement terms.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer was notified of the hold event.

attributes.name: defect_density_threshold_exceeded
attributes.description: Indicator whether the hold was triggered by defect density exceeding acceptable limits.

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Action taken upon hold release or closure (resume normal processing, rework, scrap, quarantine, return to customer, engineering review).

attributes.name: disposition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the disposition decision, corrective actions taken, or investigation findings.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the hold has been escalated to senior engineering or management for resolution.

attributes.name: hold_cycle_time_hours
attributes.description: Duration in hours between hold placement and release, used for cycle time tracking and excursion management KPIs.

attributes.name: hold_expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold automatically expires if not explicitly released or extended, used for time-bound holds.

attributes.name: hold_placement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was placed on the lot, representing the principal business event timestamp.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for placing the lot on hold (e.g., process excursion, quality issue, engineering investigation, customer request).

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason for the hold, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: hold_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was released and the lot was cleared to resume processing. Null if hold is still active.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hold event (active, released, cancelled, expired).

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hold event by functional area or trigger source (engineering, quality, process excursion, customer, equipment, material, safety). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|quality|process_excursion|customer|equipment|material|safety — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: initiating_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system that triggered the hold event (e.g., MES, SPC, ATE, manual entry).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hold record was last updated in the data system.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the wafer lot under hold, typically assigned by MES system.

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the MES system that recorded this hold event.

attributes.name: ncr_number
attributes.description: Non-conformance report number associated with the hold event, if a formal NCR was raised.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency classification for resolving the hold (critical, high, medium, low), used for escalation and resource allocation.

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause determined during investigation (e.g., equipment malfunction, operator error, material defect).

attributes.name: spc_rule_violation
attributes.description: Specific SPC rule that was violated and triggered the hold (e.g., Western Electric Rule 1, 2, 3, 4).

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot at the time the hold was placed.

products.name: lot_disposition
products.description: Transactional record of final or interim lot disposition decisions including scrap, rework, accept, downgrade, or ship-as-is. Captures disposition type, disposition authority, disposition date, affected wafer count, yield impact, and root cause classification. Authoritative record for lot closure and yield accounting.

attributes.name: lot_disposition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot disposition record. Primary key for the lot disposition entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lot disposition approvals are recorded; linking to employee supports traceability and financial liability reports.

attributes.name: capa_record_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated corrective action record if corrective action is required. Links to the corrective action entity for CAPA tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Financial reporting of lot disposition costs requires linking each disposition to the responsible cost center for expense allocation.

attributes.name: fab_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fabrication facility where the disposition decision was made. Links to the fab entity for multi-site operations.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fabrication equipment associated with the disposition event. Links to the equipment entity for equipment-related root causes.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rework process route assigned to the lot if disposition type is rework. Defines the sequence of process steps for lot recovery.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fabrication process step where the issue triggering disposition was detected. Links to the process step entity.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the wafer lot subject to this disposition decision. Links to the wafer lot entity in the fabrication domain.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the target product specification if disposition type is downgrade. Represents the lower-grade product to which the lot is reassigned.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production area where the disposition event occurred. Links to the work center entity for area-level tracking.

attributes.name: affected_wafer_count
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot subject to this disposition decision. Represents the quantity of wafers impacted by the disposition action.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition decision was approved. Represents the moment of final authorization.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a formal corrective action is required to prevent recurrence. Triggers Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition record was first created in the system. Audit field for record creation tracking.

attributes.name: customer_approval_received
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether customer approval has been received for ship-as-is or downgrade dispositions. Applicable when customer notification is required.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether customer notification is required for this disposition decision. True if Product Change Notification (PCN) or customer approval is needed.

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized defect classification code from the fab defect taxonomy. Links to the defect type reference table for detailed defect characteristics.

attributes.name: defect_die_count
attributes.description: Total number of defective or failing die across all wafers in the lot at the time of disposition. Used for yield loss analysis.

attributes.name: disposition_authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, role, or system that authorized the disposition decision. Typically a quality engineer, production supervisor, or automated MES rule.

attributes.name: disposition_authority_role
attributes.description: Organizational role of the disposition authority. Defines the level of authorization for the disposition decision.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposition decision was made. Business event date for the disposition action.

attributes.name: disposition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to the disposition decision. Captures additional context, special instructions, or engineering judgment.

attributes.name: disposition_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the disposition decision. Format: DISP-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX where YYYYMMDD is date and XXXXXX is sequence.

attributes.name: disposition_of_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Disposition decisions reference the lot being dispositioned. Required for lot closure and yield accounting.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disposition decision. Pending: awaiting approval. Approved: authorized for execution. Rejected: disposition denied. Executed: disposition action completed. Cancelled: disposition voided.

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the disposition decision was recorded in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Captures exact moment of disposition event.

attributes.name: disposition_type
attributes.description: Type of disposition decision applied to the lot. Accept: lot meets specifications and proceeds. Scrap: lot is discarded. Rework: lot requires reprocessing. Downgrade: lot is reassigned to lower grade. Hold: lot is quarantined pending review. Ship-as-is: lot ships with known deviations under waiver.

attributes.name: executed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that executed the disposition action. Captures who performed the physical disposition.

attributes.name: executed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition action was physically executed. Represents the moment when the lot was scrapped, moved to rework, or released.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the disposition decision in USD. Includes scrap cost, rework cost, or revenue loss from downgrade. Used for cost accounting and yield loss reporting.

attributes.name: good_die_count
attributes.description: Total number of Known Good Die (KGD) across all wafers in the lot at the time of disposition. Used for yield accounting and financial valuation.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for hold disposition. Links to the hold reason reference table for detailed hold classification and tracking.

attributes.name: lot_yield_percent
attributes.description: Calculated yield percentage for the lot at disposition time. Represents the ratio of good die to total die, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause that triggered the disposition decision. Used for Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
