attributes.description: Reference to the internal sales representative or account manager responsible for this MPW order. Used for commission tracking, design-win attribution, and customer relationship management in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ic design project record within the mpw order order entity.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Externally-known identifier for the shared wafer shuttle run in which this MPW order participates. Used to group all customer designs co-fabricated on the same wafer lot. Sourced from the fab or MPW program operator (e.g., TSMC shuttle run code, GlobalFoundries MPW run number).

attributes.name: to_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order.order_id — MPW orders are a specialized order type linked to the master order record for customer and commercial terms.

attributes.name: primary_mpw_order_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: MPW order belongs to a specific sales order; adding child-to-parent FK enables order‑level reporting and removes duplicate order_number.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tapeout record (final GDSII design submission) associated with this MPW order. Links the order to the design domain tapeout product for design-to-manufacturing traceability.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the ordered dies were delivered to the customer. Used to measure on-time delivery performance, close the order-to-cash cycle, and trigger final revenue recognition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the MPW order record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from order entry.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the order value and NRE charges (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency billing for international fabless customers.

attributes.name: design_name
attributes.description: Name or code of the customer's IC design (chip project) being fabricated in this MPW slot. Used for design-to-order traceability, customer communication, and design-win reporting in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: design_revision
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier of the customer's IC design submitted for this MPW run (e.g., v1.0, Rev-B, tapeout_2). Ensures the correct GDSII version is linked to the order for traceability and re-spin management.

attributes.name: die_count
attributes.description: The die count of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: die_quantity
attributes.description: The die quantity of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: die_quantity_delivered
attributes.description: Actual number of known-good dies (KGD) delivered to the customer from this MPW order. May differ from die_quantity_ordered due to yield loss. Used for fulfillment reconciliation and yield-adjusted billing.

attributes.name: die_quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of known-good dies (KGD) ordered by the customer from this MPW shuttle run. Used for delivery planning, yield-adjusted fulfillment, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: die_size_mm2
attributes.description: The die size mm2 of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: The expected delivery date associated with the mpw order order record.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) applicable to the IC design in this MPW order. Required for export license determination and BIS/EAR compliance reporting. Example values: EAR99, 3E001, 3A001.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the wafer fabrication facility (FAB) where this MPW shuttle run is manufactured (e.g., internal fab or OSAT partner site code). Used for capacity planning, yield tracking, and export compliance (ITAR/EAR).

attributes.name: itar_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MPW order involves ITAR-controlled technology requiring State Department licensing and restricted handling. True = ITAR-controlled; False = not ITAR-controlled. Drives access controls and shipment documentation requirements.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Fab-assigned wafer lot number for the MPW shuttle run associated with this order. Used for WIP tracking in Camstar MES, yield analysis, and defect traceability through the fabrication process.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: The number of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The status of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: mpw_program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MPW shuttle program under which this order is placed. Determines pricing tiers, slot priority, NRE subsidies, and export control applicability (e.g., government programs may require ITAR review).

attributes.name: mpw_to_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — MPW orders may be linked to a parent sales order for billing and customer relationship tracking.

attributes.name: mpw_to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — MPW orders are a specialized order type that should link back to the parent sales order for billing and customer relationship tracking.

attributes.name: nre_amount
attributes.description: The nre amount of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: nre_amount_usd
attributes.description: The nre amount usd of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: nre_charge_usd
attributes.description: One-time Non-Recurring Engineering charge billed to the customer for mask set preparation, reticle slot allocation, and design-in support for this MPW order. Expressed in US dollars. Shared proportionally among shuttle participants based on reticle slot area.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer formally placed the MPW order. Represents the principal business event date for order-to-cash lifecycle tracking and backlog reporting.

attributes.name: order_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing special instructions, customer-specific requirements, design constraints, or internal processing notes associated with this MPW order. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the MPW order from initial entry through fabrication completion. Drives backlog management, revenue recognition, and customer communication workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|confirmed|tapeout_received|wafer_started|in_fab|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_value_usd
attributes.description: Total monetary value of this MPW order in US dollars, comprising NRE charges plus die unit price multiplied by ordered quantity. Used for backlog reporting, revenue forecasting, and SAP FI billing.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Semiconductor package type requested for the delivered dies (e.g., bare die/KGD, WLCSP, BGA, QFN, flip-chip). Determines OSAT engagement, packaging cost, and delivery lead time. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bare_die|WLCSP|BGA|QFN|flip_chip|CSP — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: Committed date by which the ordered dies are planned to be delivered to the customer after wafer fabrication, dicing, and optional packaging. Used for customer delivery scheduling and order-to-cash SLA tracking.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Customer-issued purchase order number referencing this MPW order. Required for invoice matching, accounts receivable, and customer procurement compliance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order entry.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this MPW order for slot allocation, fab scheduling, and customer support escalation. Critical orders receive expedited processing and dedicated account management.

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process technology node used for this MPW shuttle run (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm). Determines the PDK, design rules, and fab site eligibility. Critical for yield modeling and NRE pricing.

attributes.name: reserved_area_mm2
attributes.description: The reserved area mm2 of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: reticle_area_mm2
attributes.description: The reticle area mm2 of the mpw order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: reticle_slot_area_mm2
attributes.description: Physical area in square millimeters allocated to this customer's design within the shared MPW reticle. Determines die size, die-per-wafer count, and proportional NRE cost allocation among shuttle participants.

attributes.name: reticle_slot_number
attributes.description: The specific slot number assigned to this customer's design on the shared MPW reticle. Each slot represents a distinct die area on the shared mask set. Slot allocation drives NRE cost sharing and die quantity calculations.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the materials and processes used in this MPW order comply with the EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances in electronic equipment. Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic sales region code associated with this MPW order (e.g., AMER, EMEA, APAC, JAPAN). Used for regional revenue reporting, quota management, and export control jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: shuttle_run_date
attributes.description: The shuttle run date associated with the mpw order order record.

attributes.name: tapeout_date
attributes.description: The tapeout date associated with the mpw order order record.

attributes.name: tapeout_deadline
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the customer must submit the final GDSII design data (tapeout) to secure their reticle slot in the MPW shuttle run. Missing this date results in slot forfeiture and potential NRE penalty.

attributes.name: tapeout_received_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the customer's final GDSII tapeout data was received and accepted by the fab or design services team. Used to confirm slot lock and trigger wafer start authorization.

attributes.name: unit_price_usd
attributes.description: Per-die price charged to the customer for the ordered die quantity from this MPW run. Expressed in US dollars. Used for revenue recognition, invoice generation, and margin analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the MPW order record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: wafer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of wafers allocated to this customer's design within the MPW shuttle run. Determines the maximum achievable die yield and is used for fab capacity reservation and WIP tracking.

attributes.name: wafer_start_date_actual
attributes.description: Actual date on which wafer fabrication was initiated for this MPW shuttle run. Compared against planned wafer start date to measure schedule adherence and TTM performance.

attributes.name: wafer_start_date_planned
attributes.description: Planned date for initiating wafer fabrication (wafer start) for this MPW shuttle run at the fab site. Used for fab capacity scheduling, WIP planning, and customer delivery commitment.

attributes.name: yield_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of good dies produced relative to the total possible dies from the allocated wafer area in this MPW run. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used for quality reporting, customer communication, and yield improvement programs.

products.name: die_bank_order
products.description: Order record for drawing down inventory from a customer-specific or generic die bank (KGD inventory held in wafer or singulated die form). Captures die bank source lot, requested die quantity, die type, package conversion instructions, requested delivery date, and fulfillment status. Supports just-in-time packaging and assembly workflows where die inventory is pre-built and orders trigger OSAT packaging runs. Distinct from wafer start orders as no new fab starts are required.

attributes.name: die_bank_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the die bank order record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that placed the die bank order. Links to the customer master for account-level reporting, design-win tracking, and allocation priority management.

attributes.name: die_bank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific die bank (customer-specific or generic KGD inventory pool) from which this order draws down inventory. Identifies the source die bank record in the inventory management system.

attributes.name: die_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the die order record within the die bank order order entity.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ic catalog record within the die bank order order entity.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer fabrication lot from which the die bank inventory was sourced. Enables full traceability from die bank order back to the originating fab lot for quality and yield analysis.

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Vendor ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) vendor designated to perform the packaging and assembly conversion for this die bank order. Drives OSAT purchase order creation and work order dispatch.

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Vendor ID

attributes.name: primary_die_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order.order_id — Die bank orders draw from pre-built inventory against a customer order for commercial and delivery tracking.

attributes.name: test_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) test program used to qualify the die bank inventory as Known Good Die. Ensures the correct test coverage was applied before die bank entry.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the packaged dies or bare die shipment was physically dispatched from the OSAT or warehouse facility. Used for on-time delivery measurement and revenue recognition triggering.

attributes.name: allocated_die_quantity
attributes.description: Number of dies formally allocated from the die bank inventory against this order. May differ from requested quantity due to partial allocation, inventory constraints, or backlog management decisions.

attributes.name: backlog_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this die bank order is currently in backlog status due to insufficient die bank inventory or OSAT capacity constraints. Used for backlog management reporting and customer communication.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for order cancellation when order_status is 'cancelled'. Supports root cause analysis of order cancellations and customer satisfaction reporting.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Internally confirmed delivery date committed to the customer after OSAT capacity and die bank inventory checks. May differ from requested delivery date due to packaging lead time or inventory availability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the die bank order record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from order entry.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the order value and unit price (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and SAP FI/CO currency translation.

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: Customer-provided purchase order number associated with this die bank order. Required for invoice matching, accounts receivable reconciliation, and customer audit trail.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: The number of the die bank order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The status of the die bank order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: die_bank_to_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Die bank drawdown orders are typically linked to a customer sales order that triggers the packaging/assembly run.

attributes.name: die_bank_to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Die bank drawdown orders link to the customer sales order that triggered the drawdown request.

attributes.name: die_form
attributes.description: Physical form in which the die inventory is held in the die bank and will be delivered. Determines whether OSAT packaging conversion is required before shipment.

attributes.name: die_part_number
attributes.description: Internal part number identifying the specific die type (IC design revision, process node, and configuration) being ordered from the die bank. Aligns with Oracle Agile PLM and SAP MM material master.

attributes.name: die_revision
attributes.description: Design revision or stepping identifier of the die (e.g., A0, B1, C2) as tracked in the PLM system. Critical for ensuring the correct silicon revision is pulled from the die bank, especially when multiple steppings coexist.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) assigned to the die product. Required for BIS/EAR export license determination and ITAR compliance screening before shipment authorization.

attributes.name: export_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a US government export license is required for this shipment based on the ECCN, destination country, and end-use screening. True triggers export compliance hold before shipment release.

attributes.name: fulfillment_date
attributes.description: The fulfillment date associated with the die bank order order record.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms rule governing delivery obligations, risk transfer, and cost responsibility between seller and buyer for this die bank order shipment. Captured in SAP SD delivery terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: kgd_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade of the Known Good Die (KGD) inventory being drawn from the die bank. Grade A represents fully tested, production-qualified die; Grade B may have minor parametric deviations; Engineering grade is for internal use only.

attributes.name: kgd_required_flag
attributes.description: The kgd required flag of the die bank order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the die bank order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the die bank order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: The order status of the die bank order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: order_value
attributes.description: Total commercial value of the die bank order (unit price × allocated die quantity), in the transaction currency. Used for revenue backlog reporting, order-to-cash financial tracking, and SOX-compliant revenue recognition.

attributes.name: osat_work_order_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Work Order Number
attributes.description: Work order or job number issued to the OSAT vendor for the packaging run triggered by this die bank order. Used for tracking assembly progress, yield, and delivery confirmation from the OSAT facility.

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Work Order Number

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Target package type for die conversion at OSAT (e.g., WLCSP, BGA, QFN, Flip-Chip, InFO, CoWoS). Specifies the packaging assembly instructions triggered by this die bank order. Null if order is for bare die or wafer delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WLCSP|BGA|QFN|flip_chip|InFO|CoWoS|CSP|LGA — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: packaging_instruction_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific package conversion instruction document that defines the assembly process, substrate, wire bond or flip-chip specifications, and test requirements for the OSAT packaging run triggered by this order.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the die bank order for allocation and OSAT scheduling purposes. Critical and high priority orders receive preferential die bank drawdown and packaging slot assignment.

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process node (technology node) of the die being ordered (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 16nm FinFET, 28nm). Critical for die bank segregation, quality traceability, and export control classification.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: The requested date associated with the die bank order order record.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested date by which the packaged or bare die shipment must be delivered. Used for OSAT scheduling, just-in-time packaging workflow planning, and on-time delivery KPI measurement.

attributes.name: requested_die_quantity
attributes.description: Number of individual dies (Known Good Die units) requested by the customer or internal order for drawdown from the die bank. Drives OSAT packaging run sizing and inventory reservation.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the die and its packaging materials comply with the EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances. Required for shipments to EU customers and for customer compliance declarations.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: ship_to_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for the shipment. Critical for export control screening (ITAR/EAR), RoHS/REACH compliance declarations, and customs documentation.

attributes.name: shipment_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the outbound shipment of packaged dies. Enables end-to-end shipment visibility and proof-of-delivery confirmation for order fulfillment closure.

attributes.name: shipped_die_quantity
attributes.description: Actual number of dies (post-packaging or in bare die form) confirmed as shipped to the customer. Used for fulfillment confirmation, revenue recognition, and DPPM tracking.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed commercial price per die unit for this order, as captured in the SAP SD pricing condition. Used for revenue recognition, margin analysis, and customer invoice generation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the die bank order record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: wafer_fab_site
attributes.description: Identifier of the wafer fabrication facility (FAB) where the source lot was manufactured. Relevant for quality traceability, site-specific yield analysis, and regulatory compliance (ITAR/EAR site-of-manufacture declarations).

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Planned and confirmed delivery schedule for customer orders, capturing multiple delivery windows per order line. Records scheduled delivery date, confirmed quantity, ship-from location (fab, OSAT, warehouse), ship-to customer location, carrier, incoterms, and schedule line status. Supports rolling delivery schedules for high-volume customers with blanket orders and periodic call-offs. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD schedule lines.

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each delivery schedule line record in the SAP S/4HANA SD schedule line table (VBEP). Primary key for the delivery_schedule data product in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sold-to customer for whom this delivery schedule is planned. Supports customer-level delivery performance analytics and blanket order management.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the freight carrier or logistics service provider assigned to transport this shipment. Used for carrier performance tracking and freight cost allocation.

attributes.name: delivery_order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Delivery schedules are defined per order line (SAP schedule lines). This is a mandatory parent-child relationship for delivery date management.

attributes.name: delivery_ship_to_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's destination ship-to location (customer site, distribution center, or consignment hub) for this delivery schedule line.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order header from which this delivery schedule line originates. Links the schedule line back to the order-to-cash transaction header.

attributes.name: primary_delivery_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific sales order line item (order item) for which this delivery schedule line is created. A single order line may have multiple schedule lines representing different delivery windows.

attributes.name: schedule_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Delivery schedule ownership is recorded for accountability in on‑time delivery performance reports.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, or packaged die) being scheduled for delivery on this schedule line.

attributes.name: origin_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating ship-from location for this delivery schedule line. May be a wafer fabrication facility (FAB), OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) site, or finished goods warehouse.

attributes.name: to_order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Delivery schedules define delivery windows per order line. delivery_schedule.order_line_id → order_line.order_line_id.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipment was confirmed as received at the customer's ship-to location. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) KPI calculation and customer satisfaction reporting.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the shipment physically departed the ship-from location. Populated upon goods issue posting in SAP. Used for on-time shipment performance measurement.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank assigned to this delivery schedule line during constrained supply allocation. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by supply chain planners to allocate limited wafer or die inventory across competing customer orders.

attributes.name: backlog_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery schedule line is currently in backlog status (confirmed delivery date is past due or confirmed quantity is less than ordered quantity). Used for backlog management reporting and customer escalation tracking.

attributes.name: blanket_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery schedule line is part of a blanket (framework) order with periodic call-offs. Blanket orders are common for high-volume semiconductor customers with rolling delivery schedules.

attributes.name: call_off_number
attributes.description: The specific call-off or release number issued by the customer against a blanket order for this delivery schedule line. Identifies the periodic release instruction within the blanket order framework.

attributes.name: committed_date
attributes.description: The committed date associated with the delivery schedule order record.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the semiconductor manufacturer to the customer after availability check (ATP) and capacity validation. May differ from the requested date due to wafer fab cycle time or OSAT capacity constraints.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity confirmed by the manufacturer for delivery on this schedule line after ATP (Available-to-Promise) check. May be less than ordered quantity due to allocation constraints or yield limitations.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the semiconductor product was manufactured (wafer fab or final assembly location). Required for customs declarations, tariff classification, and export control compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery schedule line record was first created in the source SAP S/4HANA SD system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from order entry.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction value fields on this delivery schedule line (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency semiconductor sales operations.

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of units shipped and delivered against this schedule line. Populated from goods issue and proof-of-delivery confirmation. Used to compute open backlog.

attributes.name: delivery_document_number
attributes.description: SAP outbound delivery document number (SD delivery order) created against this schedule line. Links the schedule line to the physical goods issue and shipping execution documents.

attributes.name: delivery_priority
attributes.description: The delivery priority of the delivery schedule record in the order domain.

attributes.name: die_bank_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number for a die bank order when delivery is fulfilled from pre-tested Known Good Die (KGD) inventory rather than a new wafer start. Supports die bank fulfillment tracking in the order-to-cash lifecycle.

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to the semiconductor product on this schedule line per the US Commerce Control List (CCL). Determines applicable export license requirements. Examples: 3A001 (electronic components), 3E001 (technology for IC design).

attributes.name: export_control_status
attributes.description: Export control compliance status for this delivery schedule line. Semiconductor shipments may be subject to EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations), or CHIPS Act restrictions. 'blocked' prevents shipment until clearance is obtained.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment for this delivery schedule line contains hazardous materials (e.g., certain chemical compounds in semiconductor packaging). Triggers special handling, labeling, and documentation requirements per RoHS and REACH regulations.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between the semiconductor manufacturer and the customer for this delivery. Governs freight cost allocation and insurance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code for this delivery schedule line (e.g., 'FOB Shanghai', 'DAP Austin TX'). Required by ICC Incoterms 2020 to complete the delivery terms specification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the delivery schedule record in the order domain.

attributes.name: last_reschedule_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for the most recent rescheduling of this delivery schedule line (e.g., 'wafer yield shortfall', 'OSAT capacity constraint', 'customer push-out request', 'export hold'). Supports root cause analysis for delivery performance.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this delivery schedule line record in the source SAP S/4HANA SD system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change detection in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Semiconductor production lot number (wafer lot or assembly lot) assigned to the units being delivered on this schedule line. Enables full traceability from customer delivery back to wafer fabrication and process parameters. Sourced from Camstar MES lot tracking.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the delivery schedule record in the order domain.

attributes.name: mpw_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery schedule line is associated with a Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) order, where multiple customer designs share a single wafer run. MPW orders have distinct lead times and delivery constraints.

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Net monetary value of the confirmed quantity on this delivery schedule line in the transaction currency. Calculated as confirmed quantity multiplied by the agreed unit price. Used for revenue recognition, backlog valuation, and SOX financial reporting.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers) originally ordered by the customer on this schedule line. Expressed in the sales unit of measure (e.g., pieces, wafers).

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: The physical packaging format for the semiconductor units being delivered on this schedule line. Packaging type affects handling, storage, and customer assembly line compatibility. Common formats include tape-and-reel (for SMT), tray, tube, bulk, waffle pack, and bare wafer.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields on this schedule line. Common semiconductor units include PC (pieces/individual ICs), WF (wafers), KGD (Known Good Die), LOT (production lot), REEL (tape-and-reel packaging), TRAY (tray packaging).

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date originally requested by the customer for this schedule line. Represents the customer's desired receipt date and is the baseline for on-time delivery (OTD) measurement.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the semiconductor product being delivered on this schedule line is compliant with the EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Directive. Required for shipments to EU customers and increasingly mandated globally.

attributes.name: sap_schedule_line_category
attributes.description: SAP SD schedule line category code controlling the delivery and goods movement behavior of this schedule line (e.g., CP = standard delivery with transfer of requirements, CN = no goods movement). Sourced from SAP VBEP-ETTYP.

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this delivery schedule entry within the parent order line item. Used to order multiple delivery windows for the same order line (e.g., line 1 = 500 units on date A, line 2 = 500 units on date B).

attributes.name: schedule_line_revision
attributes.description: Revision counter tracking how many times this delivery schedule line has been modified (date changes, quantity adjustments, rescheduling). Supports audit trail requirements and customer change notification (PCN) tracking.

attributes.name: schedule_line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle status of this delivery schedule line. Drives backlog management, delivery performance reporting, and customer communication. 'blocked' indicates an export control or credit hold.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: The schedule status of the delivery schedule record in the order domain.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The scheduled delivery date associated with the delivery schedule order record.

attributes.name: scheduled_quantity
attributes.description: The scheduled quantity of the delivery schedule record in the order domain.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which the shipment is expected to leave the ship-from location (fab, OSAT, or warehouse). Calculated by subtracting transit lead time from the confirmed delivery date.

attributes.name: shipment_tracking_number
attributes.description: External carrier-assigned tracking number (AWB, BOL, or parcel tracking ID) for the shipment associated with this delivery schedule line. Enables real-time shipment visibility and proof-of-delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_number
attributes.description: Wafer Start Authorization number linking this delivery schedule line to the authorized wafer fab start that will produce the units for this delivery. Critical for semiconductor order-to-cash lifecycle management and fab capacity planning.

attributes.name: assigned_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the assigned storage location record within the delivery schedule order entity.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Physical shipment record tracking the outbound movement of semiconductor products from origin (fab, OSAT, distribution center) to customer destination. Header captures shipment number, carrier, tracking number, ship date, estimated and actual arrival dates, package count, gross weight, HS tariff codes, export license reference, and shipment status. Line-level detail captures shipped quantity per order line, lot numbers, wafer lot IDs, package types, serial numbers, unit of measure, and inspection certificate references. Delivery confirmation section captures proof of delivery (POD) including confirmed receipt date, receiving location, confirmed quantity, customer PO reference, discrepancy flags (quantity shortage, wrong part, damaged goods), and customer signoff reference. POD receipt triggers downstream invoice release and revenue recognition. Supports multi-leg shipments, cross-border trade compliance (EAR, ITAR), RMA dispute resolution, and full traceability from order line through physical delivery. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD outbound delivery, carrier POD data, and customer EDI 856 ASN acknowledgements.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the shipment record. Primary key for the shipment data product in the order domain.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer receiving this shipment. Used for delivery confirmation, revenue recognition, and customer service tracking.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the carrier record within the shipment order entity.

attributes.name: coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Shipment coordination role is tracked to ensure logistics responsibility and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Each shipment must reference the export license authorizing the goods, replacing the free‑text field.

attributes.name: finished_good_id
attributes.description: add column finished_good_id (BIGINT) with FK to inventory.finished_good.finished_good_id - shipments contain finished goods

attributes.name: primary_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary order record within the shipment order entity.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Shipments fulfill order lines. After merging shipment_line into shipment, the shipment entity needs direct linkage to order lines for fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: primary_shipment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order that initiated this shipment. Links the shipment back to the order-to-cash lifecycle.

attributes.name: ship_from_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ship from location record within the shipment order entity.

attributes.name: ship_from_address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ship from address record within the shipment order entity.

attributes.name: ship_to_address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ship to address record within the shipment order entity.

attributes.name: to_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order.order_id — Shipments fulfill customer orders. shipment.sales_order_id → order.sales_order_id. Critical for order-to-cash traceability.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Confirmed date the shipment physically arrived at the customer receiving location. Populated from carrier proof of delivery (POD) or customer EDI 856 acknowledgement.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advance Shipment Notice (ASN) number transmitted to the customer via EDI 856 prior to physical delivery. Enables customer warehouse receiving preparation and automated goods receipt.

attributes.name: carrier_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment. Enables real-time shipment visibility and customer self-service tracking via carrier portals.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for monetary values in this shipment record (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency operations across global semiconductor supply chains.

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: Customer-provided purchase order number referenced on the shipment and delivery documentation. Required for customer receiving, invoice matching, and accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: damaged_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer reported damaged goods upon delivery. Triggers carrier claims process, RMA initiation, and DPPM (Defective Parts Per Million) quality reporting.

attributes.name: declared_value_usd
attributes.description: Declared value of the shipment contents in US dollars for customs and insurance purposes. Required for import duty calculation and export documentation under EAR/ITAR.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date associated with the shipment order record.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the customer delivery destination. Required for export compliance screening under EAR and ITAR regulations.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_date
attributes.description: Carrier-provided estimated date of arrival at the customer destination. Used for delivery scheduling, customer communication, and on-time delivery (OTD) performance tracking.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) assigned to the semiconductor products in this shipment per the Commerce Control List (CCL). Determines applicable export license requirements.

attributes.name: freight_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total freight and logistics cost for this shipment in US dollars. Used for cost allocation, customer billing (if freight is charged), and supply chain cost analytics.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms including packaging. Required for carrier freight billing, customs declarations, and dangerous goods compliance.

attributes.name: hs_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code for the semiconductor products in this shipment. Required for customs declarations, import duties, and cross-border trade compliance.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between seller and buyer. Governs freight cost allocation and title transfer point. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inspection_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the quality inspection certificate (Certificate of Conformance or Certificate of Analysis) accompanying the shipment. Required for automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace customers.

attributes.name: is_multi_leg
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment involves multiple transportation legs (e.g., fab to OSAT to customer, or cross-border transshipment). Enables multi-leg shipment tracking and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the shipment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: lot_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of manufacturing lot numbers (wafer lot IDs) included in this shipment. Enables full traceability from customer delivery back to wafer fabrication and process engineering records in Camstar MES.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the shipment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or customer-specific delivery requirements associated with this shipment (e.g., ESD handling, temperature-controlled transport).

attributes.name: origin_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the origin facility from which the shipment departed — fab, OSAT, or distribution center. Used for multi-leg shipment traceability and supply chain analytics.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Total number of physical packages (boxes, reels, trays, tubes) included in this shipment. Used for carrier manifest, customs declaration, and receiving verification.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Physical packaging format used for the semiconductor products in this shipment. Determines handling requirements, ESD protection, and customer assembly line compatibility.

attributes.name: pod_confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed as received by the customer at the delivery location per the proof of delivery (POD). Compared against shipped_quantity to identify shortages or overages.

attributes.name: pod_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the customer confirmed receipt of the shipment as captured in the proof of delivery (POD). Triggers downstream invoice release and revenue recognition in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: pod_signoff_reference
attributes.description: Customer signoff reference or electronic signature identifier from the proof of delivery document. Serves as legal evidence of delivery completion for dispute resolution and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: quantity_shortage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer reported a quantity shortage at delivery (POD confirmed quantity less than shipped quantity). Triggers discrepancy investigation and potential credit memo.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contents comply with EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction. Required for EU market access.

attributes.name: receiving_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific customer receiving dock, warehouse, or facility where the shipment was delivered. Used for multi-site customer delivery routing and POD reconciliation.

attributes.name: rma_reference_number
attributes.description: Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number associated with this shipment if a return or dispute has been initiated. Links shipment to the RMA and reverse logistics process.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all semiconductor products in this shipment comply with the EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Directive. Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Carrier service tier selected for this shipment (e.g., overnight, express, standard ground). Determines transit time commitment and freight cost.

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment physically departed the origin facility (fab, OSAT, or distribution center). Principal business event date for the shipment transaction.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable shipment identifier used in carrier communications, customer EDI 856 ASN, and logistics documentation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD outbound delivery number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shipment. Drives downstream processes including invoice release and revenue recognition upon delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers) physically shipped in this shipment. Expressed in the base unit of measure (UOM) for the product.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: The total weight kg of the shipment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The tracking number of the shipment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the shipped quantity. EA = each (packaged IC), WFR = wafer, DIE = individual die, REEL = tape-and-reel, TRAY = JEDEC tray, TUBE = IC tube.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the shipment record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: wrong_part_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer reported receipt of an incorrect part number or product. Triggers RMA process, root cause analysis, and corrective action in the quality management system.

products.name: shipment_line
products.description: Line-level detail of a shipment record, linking specific order lines and quantities to a physical shipment. Captures shipped quantity, unit of measure, lot number, wafer lot ID, package type, serial numbers (where applicable), and inspection certificate references. Enables traceability from customer order line to physical shipment and supports RMA and quality dispute resolution.

attributes.name: shipment_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shipment line record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the shipment_line data product.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wafer lot from which the shipped dies or packaged ICs originated. Enables fab-level traceability from customer shipment back to wafer fabrication run in the MES.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Multi-Project Wafer run from which this shipment line's product originated. Enables traceability for MPW orders where multiple customer designs share a single wafer fabrication run.

attributes.name: primary_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary order line record within the shipment line order entity.

attributes.name: primary_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment header record. Links this line to the physical shipment event (HEADER_REFERENCE per TRANSACTION_LINE role).

attributes.name: primary_shipment_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order line that this shipment line fulfills. Enables traceability from physical shipment back to the originating sales order line in the order-to-cash lifecycle.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, etc.) being shipped on this line. RESOURCE_REFERENCE per TRANSACTION_LINE role.

attributes.name: to_order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Critical fulfillment traceability link. Each shipment line fulfills a specific order line. Required for order fulfillment tracking, partial shipment management, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: to_shipment_id
attributes.description: FK to order.shipment.shipment_id — Fundamental header-to-line relationship. Every shipment line must belong to exactly one shipment.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the product was physically handed over to the carrier or freight forwarder. Used for on-time shipment performance, revenue recognition trigger, and export documentation.

attributes.name: advance_ship_notice_number
attributes.description: EDI Advance Ship Notice (ASN/856) document number transmitted to the customer prior to shipment. Enables customer receiving automation and inventory planning.

attributes.name: backorder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment line represents a partial fulfillment of a backordered quantity, where the full ordered quantity could not be shipped due to inventory allocation constraints.

attributes.name: certificate_of_conformance_number
attributes.description: Document number of the Certificate of Conformance issued by quality assurance, attesting that the shipped product meets all specified requirements. Required for automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace customers.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the semiconductor product was manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations, export control (EAR/ITAR), and RoHS/REACH compliance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit selling price and line value (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Required for multi-currency order management.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: Customer-assigned part number or device designation for the shipped product. Required for customer-facing shipping documents, ASN (Advance Ship Notice), and design-in traceability.

attributes.name: date_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing date code in YYWW format (year + work week) indicating when the product was fabricated or assembled. Required for shelf-life management, FIFO inventory rotation, and customer quality audits.

attributes.name: delivery_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible SAP outbound delivery document number associated with this shipment line, used for customer communication and logistics coordination.

attributes.name: die_bank_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the die bank order from which known good dies (KGD) were drawn for this shipment. Applicable when shipping bare dies or KGD from die bank inventory rather than packaged product.

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to this product line item per the US Commerce Control List (CCL). Required for EAR compliance screening and export license determination for semiconductor products.

attributes.name: goods_issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when goods issue was posted in SAP, marking the transfer of ownership and triggering revenue recognition and inventory reduction. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this transaction line.

attributes.name: inspection_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the quality inspection certificate (Certificate of Conformance or Certificate of Analysis) issued for this shipment line. Links to quality records from KLA ICOS inspection systems and QM module.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment line item is subject to ITAR controls as a defense article or defense service. When true, requires State Department export license and end-use certificate.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the shipment line record in the order domain.

attributes.name: line_net_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this shipment line (shipped_quantity × unit_selling_price after applicable discounts). Used for revenue recognition, invoice generation, and SOX financial reporting.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent shipment, used to order and reference individual line items. LINE_SEQUENCE per TRANSACTION_LINE role.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle status of this shipment line. Tracks progression from open through picking, packing, shipment, and delivery confirmation or cancellation.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot number assigned during wafer fabrication or assembly. Critical for traceability, quality dispute resolution, and RMA processing. Sourced from Camstar MES lot management.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the shipment line record in the order domain.

attributes.name: moisture_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: JEDEC moisture sensitivity level classification for the shipped packaged IC. Determines floor life, storage, and baking requirements at the customer's SMT assembly facility.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity requested on the customer order line for this product. Enables calculation of fulfillment rate and identification of short-ships or over-ships.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Semiconductor package type for the shipped product (e.g., BGA, QFN, WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, TSOP, DIP, SOP). attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Physical packaging configuration used for the shipped semiconductor units. Determines handling requirements, moisture sensitivity level (MSL), and customer SMT assembly compatibility.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer part number (MPN) for the shipped semiconductor product as listed in the product catalog and on the shipping documentation. Used for customer identification and BOM matching.

attributes.name: partial_shipment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line represents a partial shipment against the order line quantity. When true, additional shipment lines are expected to fulfill the remaining ordered quantity.

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Committed delivery date for this shipment line as agreed with the customer at order entry. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement and customer SLA tracking.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped product complies with EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction. Required for EU market access and supply chain transparency.

attributes.name: revision_level

attributes.name: rohs_compliant

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The serial number of the shipment line record in the order domain.

attributes.name: serial_number_range_end
attributes.description: Ending serial number of the serialized unit range included in this shipment line. Used with serial_number_range_start to define the complete set of serialized units shipped.

attributes.name: serial_number_range_start
attributes.description: Starting serial number of the serialized unit range included in this shipment line. Applicable for high-value or security-sensitive ICs requiring individual unit traceability (e.g., automotive, military-grade).

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers, etc.) physically shipped on this line. LINE_QUANTITY per TRANSACTION_LINE role. May differ from ordered quantity due to partial shipments or allocation constraints.

attributes.description: Operating temperature range grade of the shipped IC (commercial: 0–70°C, industrial: -40–85°C, automotive: -40–125°C, military: -55–125°C). Critical for customer application qualification and IATF 16949 automotive compliance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the shipped quantity. Common semiconductor UoMs include EA (each/die), WFR (wafer), LOT (production lot), REEL (tape-and-reel packaging), TRAY (IC tray), BOX (carton). Aligned with SAP base UoM.

attributes.name: unit_selling_price
attributes.description: Agreed selling price per unit for this shipment line as invoiced to the customer. LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT per TRANSACTION_LINE role. Sensitive commercial pricing data.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this shipment line record. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit compliance, and Silver Layer delta processing.

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_number

attributes.name: yield_grade

products.name: backlog_position
products.description: Point-in-time snapshot of open order backlog for a specific order line, capturing unshipped committed quantity, backlog value, original promise date, current commit date, and backlog aging in days.
