Direct: sold directly to end customer; Distributor: fulfilled via authorized stocking distributor; Rep Firm: managed through manufacturer's representative; OEM: original equipment manufacturer direct program; EMS: electronics manufacturing services partner.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the blanket order agreement becomes legally binding and call-off releases may begin. Marks the start of the contract period, typically aligned with the customer's fiscal year or program start.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The effective end date associated with the blanket order order record.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date associated with the blanket order order record.

attributes.name: end_market_segment
attributes.description: The primary end-market application segment for the product covered by this blanket order. Used for revenue segmentation, demand planning, and strategic reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|mobile|computing|industrial|iot|ai_datacenter|aerospace_defense|consumer|networking|medical — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the blanket order agreement expires and no further call-off releases may be issued. Typically 12 to 24 months from the effective date for semiconductor OEM and automotive Tier-1 agreements.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) for the product covered by this blanket order. Determines whether an export license is required for shipment to the customer's country. Critical for semiconductor products subject to BIS/EAR controls.

attributes.name: export_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license is required to ship product under this blanket order to the customer's destination country based on the ECCN and end-use classification. Triggers compliance review workflow when True.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between Semiconductors and the customer for shipments under this blanket agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product or technology covered by this blanket order is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) controls. When True, additional compliance approvals and end-use certificates are required before shipment.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this blanket order record in the source system. Tracks amendments to pricing, quantities, dates, or terms. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_release_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent call-off release order issued against this blanket agreement. Used to monitor customer ordering activity, identify dormant blankets, and trigger account management follow-up.

attributes.name: lead_time_weeks
attributes.description: The agreed manufacturing and delivery lead time in weeks from call-off release order placement to customer delivery. Encompasses wafer fab cycle time, assembly and test (OSAT), and logistics. Critical for wafer start authorization scheduling.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity per individual call-off release order as agreed in the blanket contract. Enforces production lot efficiency and wafer start economics. Expressed in the same unit of measure as committed_quantity.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the blanket order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: ncnr_coverage_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the committed quantity or blanket value that is subject to NCNR terms. A value of 100 means the entire commitment is NCNR; partial NCNR coverage is common in distributor agreements.

attributes.name: ncnr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the blanket order is subject to Non-Cancellable Non-Returnable (NCNR) terms. When True, the customer cannot cancel or return product once a release order is issued. Standard for automotive and high-volume OEM semiconductor supply agreements.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the blanket order agreement. Draft: under negotiation; Active: binding and open for call-offs; On Hold: temporarily suspended; Partially Released: some call-off orders issued; Fully Released: all committed quantity has been called off; Closed: contract period ended; Cancelled: terminated before expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|on_hold|partially_released|fully_released|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code defining the invoice due date, early payment discount conditions, and payment schedule applicable to release orders issued under this blanket agreement (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30).

attributes.name: pricing_tier_structure
attributes.description: Defines the pricing model applied to this blanket order. Fixed: single price for all quantities; Volume Tiered: unit price decreases at defined quantity thresholds; Time Tiered: price adjusts at defined calendar intervals; Milestone Tiered: price adjusts upon reaching program milestones such as design-in or production ramp.

attributes.name: product_part_number
attributes.description: The Semiconductors internal part number (device identifier) for the IC, SoC, ASIC, or FPGA product covered by this blanket order. Aligns with the product master in SAP MM and Oracle Agile PLM.

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the committed and released quantities. EA = each (packaged unit); WFR = wafer; DIE = bare die; REEL = tape-and-reel packaging unit; TRAY = tray packaging unit. Aligns with SAP MM unit of measure configuration.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product and its packaging materials comply with EU REACH Regulation (EC No 1907/2006) requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction. Required for EU market access.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: release_order_to_blanket
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Individual sales orders (release orders) are created against blanket orders. The sales order must reference its parent blanket for volume tracking.

attributes.name: released_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity that has been called off against this blanket order through individual release orders to date. Used to track consumption of the committed volume and compute remaining open quantity.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days prior to the expiry date by which either party must provide written notice to prevent automatic renewal or to initiate renegotiation of the blanket agreement terms.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product shipped under this blanket order is compliant with the EU RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU) restricting hazardous substances in electronic equipment. Mandatory for EU market shipments.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: sales_order_to_blanket
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Individual sales orders are call-offs against blanket orders. This link is critical for blanket quantity consumption tracking and volume commitment management.

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary customer delivery destination under this blanket agreement. Used for export control classification, logistics routing, and trade compliance screening.

attributes.name: total_blanket_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the blanket order agreement, calculated as committed_quantity multiplied by agreed_unit_price (or sum of tier values). Represents the maximum revenue commitment from this customer for the contract period. Used for revenue forecasting and SOX financial reporting.

attributes.name: total_committed_quantity
attributes.description: The total committed quantity of the blanket order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: total_committed_value
attributes.description: The total committed value of the blanket order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: total_committed_value_usd
attributes.description: The total committed value usd of the blanket order record in the order domain.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: The validity end date associated with the blanket order order record.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: The validity start date associated with the blanket order order record.

products.name: order_hold
products.description: Record of holds placed on a sales order or order line that prevent further processing or shipment. Captures hold type (credit hold, export compliance hold, quality hold, customer request hold), hold reason, hold date, hold owner, release date, release approver, and resolution notes. Supports order management workflows where orders must be paused pending credit approval, export license verification, or quality disposition. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order block management.
products.reference: SAP SD Order Block / Delivery Block

attributes.name: order_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each hold record placed on a sales order or order line within the SAP S/4HANA SD order block management module. Primary key for the order.hold data product.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality lot or wafer lot under disposition that triggered a QUALITY hold on the order. Links to the quality domain for full traceability between order holds and quality management workflows. Null for non-quality holds.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run associated with the held order, if applicable. Enables traceability between order holds and MPW shuttle schedules, which have fixed tapeout and delivery dates that may be impacted by hold duration.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item on which this hold is placed. Null if the hold applies to the entire sales order header rather than a specific line. Enables line-level hold granularity for partial shipment scenarios.

attributes.name: order_placed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order placed by employee record within the order hold order entity.

attributes.name: primary_order_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or team responsible for managing and resolving this hold. Typically the credit analyst, export compliance officer, quality engineer, or customer service representative who initiated or owns the hold. Links to the workforce domain for accountability tracking.

attributes.name: primary_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary order record within the order hold order entity.

attributes.name: tertiary_order_escalation_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the senior manager or compliance officer to whom the hold has been escalated. Null if not escalated. Enables accountability tracking for escalated holds and management reporting.

attributes.name: trade_compliance_hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_compliance_hold. Business justification: Order holds can be triggered by a trade compliance hold; linking enables root‑cause analysis.

attributes.name: chips_act_review_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: CHIPS Act Compliance Review Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold requires a CHIPS Act compliance review, particularly for orders involving customers or end-uses that may conflict with CHIPS Act guardrail provisions restricting expansion of semiconductor manufacturing capacity in countries of concern.

tag_set.value: CHIPS Act Compliance Review Required Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hold record was first created in the data platform. Represents the audit trail creation timestamp for the Silver layer record, distinct from the hold_date which captures the business event time.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_amount
attributes.description: The customer credit exposure amount in the order currency at the time the credit hold was placed. Applicable only for CREDIT hold type. Represents the outstanding accounts receivable balance plus open order value that triggered the credit block in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: The approved credit limit for the customer at the time the credit hold was placed. Applicable only for CREDIT hold type. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-AR credit management. Used to calculate credit utilization and assess hold severity.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the credit exposure and credit limit amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency semiconductor customer accounts.

attributes.name: customer_request_reference
attributes.description: Customer-provided reference number, purchase order amendment number, or communication reference that authorized or requested the hold. Applicable for CUSTOMER_REQUEST hold type. Enables traceability between the hold and the customer's formal request documentation in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: die_bank_impacted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold has blocked shipment from the die bank inventory associated with the sales order. True = die bank order is impacted; False = die bank order is not affected. Used for die bank inventory management and allocation planning.

attributes.name: dppm_threshold
attributes.description: The Defective Parts Per Million (DPPM) threshold that was exceeded and triggered the quality hold. Captures the specific quality metric breach driving the hold for QUALITY hold types. Used for quality performance analysis and customer quality reporting.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was escalated to senior management or a compliance officer. Null if the hold has not been escalated. Used to measure escalation response time and management intervention frequency.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold has been escalated to senior management or a compliance officer due to complexity, duration, or business impact. True = escalated; False = not escalated. Triggers escalation workflow notifications in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) or USML category of the product on the held order that triggered the export compliance review. Captures the specific classification driving the hold for EXPORT_COMPLIANCE hold types. Aligns with EAR/BIS and ITAR regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: export_license_number
attributes.description: The export license or authorization number being verified or awaited when the hold type is EXPORT_COMPLIANCE. References the specific BIS/EAR license, ITAR authorization, or equivalent export control document required before shipment can proceed. Null for non-export-compliance holds.

attributes.name: hold_code
attributes.description: Coded value representing the hold code of the order hold order record.

attributes.name: hold_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was placed on the sales order or order line. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the hold lifecycle. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order block creation timestamp.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the hold record as assigned by SAP S/4HANA SD order block management. Used in customer communications, credit team workflows, and export compliance tracking.

attributes.name: hold_placed_timestamp
attributes.description: The hold placed timestamp of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: The hold reason of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded value representing the hold reason code of the order hold order record.

attributes.name: hold_release_timestamp
attributes.description: The hold release timestamp of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: hold_released_timestamp
attributes.description: The hold released timestamp of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: hold_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The hold start timestamp of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hold record. ACTIVE = hold is in effect and order processing is blocked; RELEASED = hold has been resolved and order processing may resume; ESCALATED = hold has been escalated to senior management or compliance officer; CANCELLED = hold was voided without formal release (e.g., duplicate entry).

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hold category that determines the workflow and approval path required for release. CREDIT = credit limit exceeded or payment overdue; EXPORT_COMPLIANCE = pending export license or ITAR/EAR review; QUALITY = quality disposition pending; CUSTOMER_REQUEST = customer-initiated pause; ALLOCATION = insufficient die bank or wafer inventory; REGULATORY = RoHS/REACH/CHIPS Act compliance verification pending.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold is related to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) controlled technology or products. True = ITAR-controlled item requiring State Department authorization; False = not ITAR-controlled. Drives export compliance workflow routing and documentation requirements.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: order_value_at_risk
attributes.description: Net value of the sales order or order line blocked by this hold, expressed in the order currency. Represents the revenue at risk due to the hold and is used for business impact assessment, management reporting, and prioritization of hold resolution efforts.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Business department responsible for resolving the hold. Drives workflow routing and SLA assignment. CREDIT_MGMT = credit and collections team; EXPORT_COMPLIANCE = trade compliance and ITAR/EAR team; QUALITY = quality assurance and reliability team; CUSTOMER_SERVICE = order management team; SUPPLY_CHAIN = allocation and inventory team; FINANCE = accounts receivable.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee or team responsible for managing and resolving this hold at the time it was placed. Denormalized for operational reporting and audit trail purposes without requiring a join to the workforce domain.

attributes.name: placed_timestamp
attributes.description: The placed timestamp of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: quality_disposition_status
attributes.description: Current disposition decision status for the quality lot associated with a QUALITY hold. PENDING = disposition not yet determined; USE_AS_IS = lot approved for shipment as-is; REWORK = lot requires rework before shipment; SCRAP = lot scrapped, order must be re-sourced; RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER = material returned to supplier. Null for non-quality holds.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the hold was placed on the order. Captures the specific business condition triggering the block, such as credit limit exceeded amount, export license number pending, quality lot disposition reference, or customer-requested delivery pause reason. Free-text field sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order block reason text.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized SAP S/4HANA SD order block reason code (e.g., 01 = Credit Block, 02 = Export Block, 03 = Quality Block) used for systematic reporting and workflow routing. Complements the free-text hold_reason field with a machine-readable classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|03|04|05|06|07|08|09|10 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: release_approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who approved the release of the hold at the time of release. Denormalized for audit trail and compliance reporting without requiring a join to the workforce domain.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was formally released and order processing was authorized to resume. Null if the hold is still active. Used to calculate hold duration and measure order management cycle time performance.

attributes.name: release_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the resolution that enabled the hold to be released. Captures the specific action taken, such as credit limit increase approved, export license number obtained, quality lot disposition completed, or customer confirmation received. Free-text field for audit and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: The released timestamp of the order hold record in the order domain.

attributes.name: requested_release_date
attributes.description: The date by which the hold is expected or requested to be released, as agreed with the customer or set by the hold owner. Used for proactive hold management, customer commitment tracking, and delivery schedule impact assessment.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Extended free-text notes documenting the full resolution process, including any corrective actions taken, approvals obtained, reference documents reviewed, and follow-up actions required. Supports post-hold analysis and process improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold resolution exceeded the defined SLA target hours. True = SLA was breached; False = resolved within SLA. Used for order management performance reporting and customer escalation management.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hold Resolution Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Hours
attributes.description: Target number of business hours within which the hold must be resolved per the order management SLA policy. Varies by hold type: credit holds typically 24 hours, export compliance holds 72 hours, quality holds 48 hours. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and customer commitment management.

tag_set.value: Hold Resolution Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Hours

attributes.name: source_system_hold_reference
attributes.description: The native hold or order block identifier as recorded in the originating operational system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD order block number). Enables reconciliation between the Silver layer data product and the source system of record for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hold record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks the most recent update to any hold attribute, supporting change data capture, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: wafer_start_impacted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold has blocked or delayed a wafer start authorization (WSA) associated with the sales order. True = wafer start is impacted; False = wafer start is not affected. Critical for fab capacity planning and WIP management in semiconductor manufacturing.

products.name: delivery_confirmation
products.description: Customer delivery confirmation record capturing proof of delivery (POD) for semiconductor shipments. Records confirmed receipt date, confirmed quantity, receiving location, customer PO reference, discrepancy flag, discrepancy type (quantity shortage, wrong part, damaged goods), and customer signoff reference. Triggers downstream invoice release and revenue recognition events. Sourced from carrier POD data and customer EDI 856 ASN acknowledgements.
products.reference: Proof of Delivery (POD) / EDI 856 ASN Acknowledgement

attributes.name: delivery_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the delivery confirmation record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the delivery_confirmation data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who received and confirmed the semiconductor shipment. Used for downstream invoice release and revenue recognition attribution.

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery schedule record within the delivery confirmation order entity.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order associated with this delivery confirmation. Enables traceability from proof of delivery back to the originating customer order in the order-to-cash lifecycle.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order line record within the delivery confirmation order entity.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment record for which this delivery confirmation is being captured. Links the proof of delivery (POD) event back to the originating shipment.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: The Advance Shipment Notice number from the customer's EDI 856 ASN acknowledgement message. Used to correlate the delivery confirmation with the inbound EDI transaction from the customer's warehouse management or ERP system.

attributes.name: carrier_pod_reference
attributes.description: The carrier's own proof-of-delivery document reference number as provided in the carrier POD data feed. Used to reconcile the internal delivery confirmation with the carrier's logistics records and resolve freight disputes.

attributes.name: carrier_tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier's shipment tracking number associated with this delivery confirmation. Enables direct lookup in carrier portals for POD document retrieval and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: confirmation_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the delivery confirmation was received from the customer or carrier. 'edi' = Electronic Data Interchange (EDI 856/861); 'portal' = customer self-service portal; 'api' = direct API integration; 'email' = email-based confirmation; 'manual' = manually entered by customer service representative.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this delivery confirmation record. Communicated to customers and logistics partners as the official proof-of-delivery (POD) reference number. Format: DC- followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the delivery confirmation record. 'pending' indicates awaiting customer acknowledgement; 'confirmed' indicates full receipt acknowledged; 'disputed' indicates customer raised a discrepancy; 'partially_confirmed' indicates partial quantity acknowledged; 'cancelled' indicates confirmation voided.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers, or reels) confirmed as received by the customer at the destination facility. May differ from shipped quantity in cases of shortage, overage, or partial delivery. Used as the basis for invoice quantity and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: confirmed_receipt_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the customer confirmed physical receipt of the semiconductor shipment at the destination facility. This is the principal business event date for the delivery confirmation and serves as the trigger date for invoice release and revenue recognition per ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

attributes.name: confirmed_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the customer confirmed receipt of the shipment, including timezone offset. Used for SLA measurement, carrier performance analytics, and precise revenue recognition event logging.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery confirmation record was first created in the system, either via carrier POD data feed or customer EDI 856 ASN acknowledgement ingestion. Audit trail field for data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_status
attributes.description: The customer's formal acceptance decision for the delivered semiconductor product. 'accepted' = unconditional acceptance; 'rejected' = full rejection, return initiated; 'conditionally_accepted' = accepted with noted discrepancy pending resolution; 'pending_inspection' = customer incoming quality inspection in progress.

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: The customer's purchase order number as referenced on the delivery confirmation. Cross-references the customer's procurement system to the semiconductor manufacturer's order-to-cash records. Critical for invoice matching and accounts receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: customer_signoff_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer representative who signed off on the delivery confirmation at the receiving facility. Captured from carrier POD document or EDI 856 acknowledgement. Classified as confidential PII as it identifies an individual at the customer organization.

attributes.name: customer_signoff_reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier of the customer's authorized signoff on the delivery confirmation, such as a digital signature ID, customer dock receipt number, or customer ERP goods receipt document number. Required for invoice release authorization and revenue recognition event triggering.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the confirmed receipt date exceeded the committed delivery date on the sales order. Negative values indicate early delivery. Zero indicates on-time delivery. Used for carrier performance scorecards and customer SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: The delivered quantity of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date associated with the delivery confirmation order record.

attributes.name: delivery_performance_code
attributes.description: Classification of delivery performance relative to the confirmed delivery date on the sales order. 'on_time' = delivered within the committed window; 'early' = delivered before committed date; 'late' = delivered after committed date; 'partial' = partial quantity delivered; 'failed' = delivery not completed. Used for OTIF (On-Time In-Full) KPI reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: The delivery status of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The delivery timestamp of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: device_revision
attributes.description: The silicon revision or stepping of the delivered semiconductor device (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Captured at delivery confirmation to ensure the customer received the correct device revision as specified in the purchase order and product change notification (PCN).

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the discrepancy reported by the customer. Captures details not covered by the discrepancy_type enumeration, such as specific damage descriptions, lot number mismatches, or partial damage to a reel. Used in quality notification and RMA processing.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to TRUE when the customer has reported any discrepancy between the shipment contents and the delivery confirmation. Triggers downstream discrepancy resolution workflow, quality notification in SAP QM, and potential RMA initiation.

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the discrepancy reported by the customer. 'quantity_shortage' = fewer units received than shipped; 'wrong_part' = incorrect part number or device type received; 'damaged_goods' = physical damage to ICs, packaging, or wafers; 'wrong_lot' = incorrect lot number or traceability mismatch; 'labeling_error' = incorrect label or marking; 'none' = no discrepancy.

attributes.name: export_control_verified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to TRUE when export control compliance has been verified for this delivery, confirming the shipment reached the authorized end-destination and end-user as specified in the export license. Required for BIS/EAR and ITAR compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_document_number
attributes.description: The customer's ERP goods receipt document number (e.g., SAP MIGO GR document) confirming the semiconductor shipment has been posted into the customer's inventory. Provides the strongest form of delivery confirmation for invoice matching and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code governing the transfer of risk and title for this shipment. Determines the point at which delivery is legally confirmed and revenue recognition is triggered. Critical for export compliance and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_release_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to TRUE when this delivery confirmation has triggered the downstream invoice release event in SAP S/4HANA FI/SD. Enables monitoring of the order-to-cash cycle and identification of confirmed deliveries pending invoice generation.

attributes.name: invoice_release_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the invoice release event was triggered in SAP S/4HANA FI following delivery confirmation. Used for order-to-cash cycle time analytics and revenue recognition timing compliance under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to TRUE when the delivered semiconductor product is subject to ITAR controls. Triggers mandatory end-use verification and delivery confirmation audit requirements under ITAR Part 123.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The semiconductor wafer lot number associated with the delivered product. Enables full traceability from delivery confirmation back to the fabrication lot in the MES (Camstar/Applied Materials SmartFactory). Critical for quality escapes, field failure analysis, and DPPM tracking.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: package_count_confirmed
attributes.description: The number of physical packages (boxes, reels, trays, tubes) confirmed as received by the customer. Compared against the shipped package count to identify missing packages in transit. Used for carrier claims and freight audit.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's part number (MPN) of the semiconductor product delivered. Used to verify correct part delivery against the customer PO and to cross-reference with the product master in Oracle Agile PLM and SAP MM.

attributes.name: pod_source
attributes.description: The originating data source from which this delivery confirmation was captured. 'carrier_pod' = carrier electronic POD feed; 'edi_856' = customer EDI 856 ASN acknowledgement; 'customer_portal' = customer self-service portal submission; 'manual' = manually entered by customer service; 'email_confirmation' = email-based confirmation.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_reference
attributes.description: The proof of delivery reference of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_url
attributes.description: The proof of delivery url of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between shipped_quantity and confirmed_quantity (shipped minus confirmed). A positive value indicates a shortage; a negative value indicates an overage. Used to trigger discrepancy workflows and credit/debit memo processing in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: received_by
attributes.description: The received by of the delivery confirmation record in the order domain.

attributes.name: receiving_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country where the semiconductor shipment was received. Used for export control compliance verification, trade compliance reporting, and geographic revenue analytics.

attributes.name: receiving_location_code
attributes.description: The customer's facility or dock location code where the semiconductor shipment was physically received. Sourced from the customer EDI 856 ASN or carrier POD data. Used for logistics analytics and customer facility mapping.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to TRUE when this delivery confirmation has satisfied the performance obligation criteria and triggered a revenue recognition event in the financial system. Critical for SOX-compliant revenue reporting.

attributes.name: rma_reference_number
attributes.description: The Return Merchandise Authorization number issued when a discrepancy results in a product return. Populated only when discrepancy_flag is TRUE and a return has been authorized. Links the delivery confirmation to the downstream RMA and reverse logistics process.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean indicator confirming that the delivered semiconductor product complies with the EU RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU) restricting hazardous substances. Captured at delivery confirmation for regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of semiconductor units originally shipped as recorded on the shipment record. Compared against confirmed_quantity to identify shortages or overages at delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the confirmed delivery quantity. EA = each (individual packaged IC or die); REEL = tape-and-reel packaging; WAFER = bare or processed wafer; TRAY = JEDEC tray; TUBE = IC tube packaging; LOT = wafer lot.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this delivery confirmation record, such as discrepancy updates, status changes, or customer signoff amendments. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: lot_assignment
products.description: Association record linking a specific wafer lot or finished goods lot to a customer order line for fulfillment traceability. Captures assigned lot number, lot type (wafer lot, die lot, packaged goods lot), assigned quantity, assignment date, assignment status (tentative, confirmed, shipped), and any lot-specific quality disposition notes. Enables full lot traceability from customer order back to wafer fabrication and forward to shipment. Critical for automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace customers requiring lot-level traceability.

attributes.name: lot_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a specific lot-to-order-line assignment record within the order-to-cash fulfillment process.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this lot assignment is made. Supports customer-level lot traceability reporting required by automotive and aerospace customers.

attributes.name: assembly_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the assembly lot record within the lot assignment order entity.

attributes.name: assignment_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lot assignment ownership links a responsible employee to each wafer lot for traceability and quality audits.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabrication wafer lot record within the lot assignment order entity.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_wafer_lot. Business justification: REQUIRED: Lot assignment process records which wafer lot is assigned to a specific order/line; FK provides direct lookup for assignment audits.

attributes.name: lot_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot order record within the lot assignment order entity.

attributes.name: lot_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order header to which this lot assignment belongs. Links the lot assignment back to the customer order for order-to-cash traceability.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle run from which this lot originates, applicable for MPW lot types. Links the assignment back to the specific MPW shuttle for design-to-delivery traceability.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item within the sales order for which this lot is being assigned. Enables line-level lot traceability for multi-line orders.

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Vendor ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) vendor responsible for packaging and assembly of the lot, if applicable. Relevant for packaged goods lots and KGD lots sourced from external assembly houses.

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Vendor ID

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound shipment record under which this lot assignment was physically dispatched. Links the lot assignment forward to the shipment for end-to-end order-to-cash traceability.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sku record within the lot assignment order entity.

attributes.name: test_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ATE (Automatic Test Equipment) test program used to qualify the lot prior to assignment. Enables traceability from the customer order back to the specific test program version used for lot qualification.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the assigned lot was physically shipped to the customer. Populated upon shipment confirmation from the MES or SAP SD goods issue posting. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank governing the order in which this lot assignment is fulfilled when supply is constrained. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by supply chain planners for backlog management and allocation decisions.

attributes.name: assigned_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units from this lot assigned to the order line. For wafer lots this represents wafer count; for die lots this represents die count; for packaged goods lots this represents unit count. Must not exceed the available lot quantity.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the lot was formally assigned to the customer order line. Used for backlog management, delivery schedule tracking, and IATF 16949 lot traceability audit trails.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: The assignment number of the lot assignment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: assignment_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the lot assignment was created. Manual indicates a planner manually assigned the lot; atp_auto indicates the SAP ATP (Available-to-Promise) engine automatically assigned it; allocation_run indicates it was created by a batch allocation run; planner_override indicates a planner overrode an automatic assignment; system_transfer indicates the assignment was transferred from another order.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lot-to-order assignment. Tentative indicates a preliminary reservation pending confirmation; confirmed indicates a firm allocation; allocated indicates inventory has been committed; shipped indicates the lot has been dispatched; cancelled indicates the assignment was voided; on_hold indicates the assignment is suspended pending quality disposition or export review.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: The assignment type of the lot assignment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: backlog_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot assignment is part of the open order backlog, meaning the order has not yet been fully shipped and revenue has not been recognized. Used for backlog reporting and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description explaining why a lot assignment was cancelled. Populated only when assignment_status is cancelled. Used for root cause analysis and supply chain performance reporting.

attributes.name: certificate_of_conformance_number
attributes.description: The certificate of conformance document number issued for this lot assignment, confirming the lot meets all specified quality and regulatory requirements. Required by automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace customers.

attributes.name: chips_act_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot assignment is associated with production eligible for US CHIPS and Science Act incentives or reporting requirements. Relevant for domestic semiconductor manufacturing compliance and subsidy tracking.

attributes.name: confirmed_ship_date
attributes.description: The confirmed date on which the assigned lot is scheduled to ship to the customer. Drives delivery commitment and ATP (Available-to-Promise) calculations in SAP SD.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country where the lot was manufactured. Required for customs declarations, tariff classification, and CHIPS Act domestic content reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lot assignment record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp required for SOX compliance and IATF 16949 traceability records.

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: The customer-provided purchase order number associated with this lot assignment. Required for invoice matching, customer receiving, and lot traceability documentation provided to the customer.

attributes.name: date_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing date code of the lot in YYYYWW format (year and work week), indicating when the lot was fabricated. Required for component traceability, shelf-life management, and customer receiving inspection.

attributes.name: dppm
attributes.description: The defective parts per million rate measured for the assigned lot. Key quality metric reported to automotive customers under IATF 16949 and AIAG quality reporting requirements.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: The Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) applicable to the lot being assigned, as required under EAR (Export Administration Regulations). Determines whether an export license is required for shipment to the customer destination country.

attributes.name: export_license_number
attributes.description: The export license number issued by BIS or DDTC authorizing shipment of this lot to the customer, where required. Must be documented on shipping documentation for EAR/ITAR compliance.

attributes.name: export_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license is required for shipment of this lot to the customer destination country based on the ECCN and destination. Drives export compliance workflow in SAP GTS.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The SAP QM inspection lot number associated with the quality inspection results for this manufacturing lot. Links the lot assignment to the formal quality inspection record for audit traceability.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot being assigned is subject to ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) controls. ITAR-controlled lots require additional compliance review and documentation before shipment.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: kgd_grade
attributes.description: The KGD (Known Good Die) quality grade assigned to the lot, applicable for die lots and advanced packaging orders. Grade A represents highest quality fully tested die; Grade B represents die meeting relaxed specifications; engineering sample and qualification grades apply to pre-production lots.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the lot assignment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing lot identifier assigned by the Camstar MES or SAP PP module. Uniquely identifies the wafer lot, die lot, or packaged goods lot being assigned to the order line. This is the primary traceability key linking customer orders back to wafer fabrication.

attributes.name: lot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lot being assigned to the order line. Distinguishes between wafer lots (silicon substrates in fabrication), die lots (singulated Known Good Die), packaged goods lots (finished assembled units), KGD (Known Good Die) lots for advanced packaging, and MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle lots.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: The model lineage source of the lot assignment record in the order domain.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The finished goods or intermediate part number (SAP material number) associated with the lot being assigned. Identifies the specific IC, die, or wafer product being fulfilled against the order line.

attributes.name: part_revision
attributes.description: The revision level of the part number associated with the assigned lot. Critical for automotive and aerospace customers who require revision-level traceability per IATF 16949 and AS9100 requirements.

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: The semiconductor fabrication process node (technology node) used to manufacture the lot, expressed in nanometers (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 28nm, 65nm). Identifies the manufacturing technology generation for the assigned lot.

attributes.name: quality_disposition
attributes.description: The quality disposition status of the lot at the time of assignment. Accepted indicates the lot passed all quality gates; conditionally accepted indicates the lot is approved with documented deviations; rejected indicates the lot failed quality inspection; under review indicates quality evaluation is in progress; quarantined indicates the lot is isolated pending investigation.

attributes.name: quality_disposition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any lot-specific quality disposition details, deviations, waivers, or special handling instructions associated with this assignment. Required for automotive customers under IATF 16949 non-conforming product management.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned lot is compliant with EU REACH Regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals). Required for EU market shipments and chemical substance reporting.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned lot is compliant with the EU RoHS Directive (Restriction of Hazardous Substances), restricting the use of specific hazardous materials in electronic equipment. Required for EU market shipments.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure applicable to the assigned quantity. Wafers for wafer lots, dies for die lots, units for packaged goods, reels or trays for tape-and-reel or tray-packaged finished goods.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lot assignment record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to the assignment for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: wafer_fab_site

attributes.name: yield_percent
attributes.description: The die yield percentage of the assigned lot, representing the proportion of good dies per wafer that passed all test and inspection criteria. Critical quality metric for automotive and aerospace customers requiring lot-level quality data.

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Quality assurance, reliability testing, defect inspection, metrology, DPPM tracking, FMEA, and qualification programs. domains.name: test
domains.description: Wafer probing, die sort, final test, and reliability testing operations. Manages ATPG programs, ATE configurations, test coverage, bin mapping, test yield, parametric test data, and correlation studies between wafer-level and package-level test. Distinct from quality domain which focuses on QMS and compliance.

products.name: test_program
products.description: Master record for ATPG-generated and manually authored test programs used on ATE platforms, with full version lifecycle management. Captures program name, target device family, test type (wafer probe, die sort, final test, burn-in, SLT), ATE platform compatibility, ATPG tool used, coverage targets, and program lifecycle status. Includes version-level tracking: version number, change description, changed test flows or limits, validation status, release date, approved-by engineer, associated PCN/ECO reference, and change impact assessment. SSOT for all test program definitions and their complete evolution history across test operations.

products.name: unit_test_result
products.description: Transactional record capturing individual unit-level test results from all test insertions including wafer probing, die sort, final test, and system-level test (SLT). Records unit identifier (X/Y die coordinates for wafer-level or device serial/unit position for package-level), test insertion stage discriminator, assigned hard-bin and soft-bin codes per bin_definition, pass/fail status, total test time, parametric measurement summary flags, retest indicator and retest count, KGD (Known Good Die) qualification status, multi-die/chiplet assembly position, and test temperature/voltage condition. Serves as the single source of truth for all unit-level test outcomes across the entire test flow, enabling wafer map generation, unit-level yield analysis, full lot traceability, and die-to-package correlation. Aligns with STDF PTR/FTR/MPR record concepts.

products.name: correlation_study
products.description: Master record for test correlation studies comparing results across different test insertions, ATE platforms, or test sites. Primarily supports wafer-probe-to-final-test correlation for KGD qualification and test cost reduction, but also covers tester-to-tester correlation, site-to-site correlation, and multi-insertion guard-band optimization. Captures study name, device type, correlation methodology (parametric, functional, combined), insertion pair under study, correlation coefficient by parameter, systematic offset values, Cpk impact analysis, guard-band recommendations, sample size and confidence level, study status, approval date, and expiration/revalidation schedule. Enables test program optimization, probe-only shipping decisions, and OSAT transfer qualification.

products.name: insertion
products.description: Reference master defining the complete test insertion architecture for each device type within the manufacturing flow. products.name: maintenance_event
products.description: Transactional record of every maintenance activity executed on a fab tool or chamber, including preventive maintenance (PM), corrective maintenance (CM), emergency breakdown repair, engineering-driven modifications, tool upgrades/retrofits, and hardware/software modifications. Captures event type, trigger (scheduled PM, alarm, operator-reported, FDC event, ECO), start/end timestamps, actual downtime duration, root cause classification (5-why, fishbone), repair actions taken, spare parts and consumables consumed (part ID, quantity, unit cost, planned vs unplanned), technician IDs, upgrade/retrofit details (upgrade type, ECO reference, pre/post configuration, performance improvement targets, baseline change flag), and return-to-service sign-off including re-qualification requirements. SSOT for tool downtime attribution, MTTR/MTBF calculation, parts consumption tracking, upgrade history, and total cost of ownership. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA PM and SmartFactory MES.

products.name: equipment_process_recipe

products.name: spc_control
products.description: Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring configuration and violation records for fab tool process parameters. Defines control chart setup (chart type: Xbar-R, EWMA, CUSUM; monitored parameter; UCL/LCL/target values; sampling frequency; Western Electric response rules) and captures out-of-control signals. products.name: oee_record

products.name: fdc_event
products.description: Fault Detection and Classification (FDC) monitoring configuration, real-time alarm management, and fault event records for fab tools per SEMI E116. Defines monitored sensor parameters (signal name, data type, engineering units, sampling rate, normal operating range, fault thresholds, classification rules) and captures all tool alarms and fault events. Records include alarm/fault ID, alarm code, type, severity (critical, major, minor, warning), alarm source (chamber, subsystem, sensor), alarm message text, affected tool and chamber, triggering parameter and value, onset/acknowledgment/clearance timestamps, associated wafer lot and recipe, automated disposition (lot hold, tool stop, alert only), escalation to maintenance event, and engineer review outcome. SSOT for real-time FDC configuration, tool alarm management, fault classification, and process excursion containment. Feeds predictive maintenance models. Sourced from SmartFactory MES FDC module.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Inventory management for WIP wafer lots, raw materials (silicon wafers, chemicals, gases, photomasks), finished goods (packaged chips), die banks, and consignment stock at OSAT partners. Tracks lot traceability, KGD status, bin classifications, shelf life, storage conditions, and inventory valuation.

products.name: inventory_wafer_lot
products.description: Master record for a wafer lot (batch of wafers) moving through the FAB as work-in-process inventory. Tracks lot ID, wafer count, process node, product code, lot type (production/engineering/qualification), priority class, current operation step, WIP status (active/hold/complete/scrapped), start date, target completion date, hold flags, cumulative scrap count, good wafer count, and MES lot reference. SSOT for WIP lot identity and traceability across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL process stages within the inventory domain.
products.reference: Camstar MES Lot Master / SAP PP WIP Lot

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the wafer lot master record within the inventory domain. Primary key for the inventory_wafer_lot data product. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — this entity represents a discrete WIP business event (a lot moving through FAB) with a clear lifecycle, party references, timestamps, and quantitative results.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this wafer lot is being fabricated. Applicable for foundry/OSAT business models where lots are customer-specific. Null for internal product lots. This is the PARTY_REFERENCE category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for allocating wafer‑lot production costs to a cost center for internal cost‑of‑goods‑sold reporting.

attributes.name: customer_design_win_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_design_win. Business justification: Required for Production Tracking Report linking each wafer lot to the originating customer design win for revenue and yield attribution.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: ECCN classification is needed for export control of wafer lots; linking lot to its ECCN record enables automated compliance checks and reporting.

attributes.name: experimental_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_lot. Business justification: Needed for the Experimental Wafer Lot Tracking report that ties research lots to physical inventory for traceability.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Export License Management requires each wafer lot to be tied to the specific export license authorizing its shipment, a standard practice in semiconductor export compliance.

attributes.name: fab_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility (FAB) where this wafer lot is being processed. Supports multi-fab inventory tracking and capacity allocation. This is the PARTY_REFERENCE / facility reference category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment unit currently processing or last processing this wafer lot. Enables equipment-to-lot traceability for defect root cause analysis and equipment qualification tracking.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the MES process route (flow plan) assigned to this wafer lot, defining the ordered sequence of operations from wafer start through final FAB step. Determines which process steps, equipment, and recipes apply to the lot.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor process technology definition (PDK / technology platform) used for this lot. Links to the technology master record which defines design rules, layer stack, and process parameters.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Required for Wafer Lot Production Traceability Report linking each wafer lot to its IC catalog; replaces denormalized product_code with a proper FK.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Wafer‑lot allocation to a specific IC design project is required for production planning and capacity reports.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MPW shuttle run if this lot is part of a multi-project wafer program. MPW lots share a single wafer with multiple customer designs to reduce NRE costs. Null for dedicated production lots.

attributes.name: process_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lot Management requires assigning a process engineer to each wafer lot for traceability, accountability, and release approval.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Enables profitability analysis per wafer lot by linking to the profit center that owns the product line.

attributes.name: reticle_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the photomask (reticle) set used for photolithography patterning of this wafer lot. Enables traceability between WIP lots and mask inventory, supporting mask defect impact analysis and OPC (Optical Proximity Correction) version tracking.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD sales order that triggered this wafer lot start. Links WIP inventory to customer demand for order-to-cash traceability and delivery commitment tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: FK to product.sku

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the storage location record within the inventory wafer lot inventory entity.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tapeout record (final design submission for manufacturing) associated with this wafer lot. Links WIP inventory to the design domain for design-to-silicon traceability and first silicon yield analysis.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the wafer lot completed all FAB process steps. Populated upon lot completion. Used for cycle time actuals, on-time delivery KPI calculation, and process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer lot master record was first created in the inventory data product (Silver layer). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: current_operation_step
attributes.description: The current process operation step name or code at which the wafer lot is positioned in the process flow (e.g., 'FEOL_Gate_Oxide', 'MOL_Contact_Etch', 'BEOL_Metal1_CVD'). Sourced from the MES process flow definition. Critical for WIP traceability and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: die_per_wafer
attributes.description: Theoretical number of die that can be patterned on a single wafer for this product at the given process node and die size. Used as the denominator for yield calculations and finished goods quantity forecasting.

attributes.name: good_wafer_count
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot that have passed all in-line inspection and metrology checks to date. Represents the current count of wafers expected to yield good die. Updated after each inspection or disposition event.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wafer lot is currently placed on hold and cannot proceed to the next process step. A True value means the lot is blocked pending engineering review, quality disposition, or management approval. Sourced from MES hold management.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the current or most recent hold placed on the wafer lot (e.g., 'PROCESS_EXCURSION', 'EQUIPMENT_FAILURE', 'YIELD_LOSS', 'CUSTOMER_REQUEST', 'ENGINEERING_REVIEW'). Populated when hold_flag is True. Used for hold disposition tracking and FMEA analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PROCESS_EXCURSION|EQUIPMENT_FAILURE|YIELD_LOSS|CUSTOMER_REQUEST|ENGINEERING_REVIEW|MATERIAL_SHORTAGE|QUALITY_DISPOSITION — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hold_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the most recent hold was placed on the wafer lot. Null if the lot has never been placed on hold. Used for hold duration tracking and SPC (Statistical Process Control) excursion response time measurement.

attributes.name: inventory_authoritative_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Authoritative FK resolving SSOT duplicate ownership

attributes.name: inventory_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to authoritative owner fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot for concept wafer_lot

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Current standard cost valuation of the wafer lot in the inventory ledger, expressed in the functional currency. Calculated based on the number of wafers and the standard cost per wafer at the current process step. Used for WIP inventory valuation in SAP FI/CO and financial reporting under SOX.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The last modified timestamp of the inventory wafer lot record in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Type of photolithography exposure technology used for the critical layers of this wafer lot. EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet) is used for leading-edge nodes (sub-7nm); DUV (Deep Ultraviolet) for mature nodes. Determines equipment routing and cost structure.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The lot number of the inventory wafer lot record in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: lot_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the wafer lot was officially started (wafer start authorization executed) in the FAB. Used for cycle time measurement, WIP aging analysis, and on-time delivery tracking. This is the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) category field.

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wafer lot within the FAB WIP flow. 'active' indicates the lot is progressing through process steps; 'on_hold' indicates a hold flag is set pending disposition; 'completed' indicates all process steps are finished; 'scrapped' indicates the lot has been disposed; 'cancelled' indicates the lot was terminated before completion. This is the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category field.

attributes.name: lot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wafer lot by its manufacturing purpose. 'production' lots are for customer shipment; 'engineering' lots support process development; 'qualification' lots validate new processes or products; 'monitor' lots track process stability; 'reliability' lots support JEDEC/IATF reliability testing. This is the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category field.

attributes.name: mes_lot_reference
attributes.description: Native lot reference number as recorded in the Applied Materials SmartFactory or Camstar MES system. Enables direct cross-reference to the operational system of record for lot tracking, dispatch, and WIP management.

attributes.name: model_lineage_source
attributes.description: Indicates this product is a referrer in SSOT resolution; authoritative data lives in the owner product

attributes.name: primary_inventory_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable lot identifier assigned by the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) at lot creation. Used across FAB operations, quality systems, and customer traceability. Corresponds to the Camstar MES Lot ID / SAP PP Production Order number. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Dispatch priority classification assigned to the wafer lot, used by MES to sequence lot movement through FAB equipment queues. 'hot' lots receive highest priority for customer-critical or yield-recovery situations; 'expedite' for accelerated delivery; 'standard' for normal flow; 'low' for non-urgent engineering runs.

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor manufacturing process technology node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 14nm, 28nm, 65nm) used to fabricate this wafer lot. Determines the Process Design Kit (PDK), equipment set, and yield expectations. Critical for capacity planning and technology roadmap tracking.

attributes.name: process_stage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Stage (Front End of Line / Middle of Line / Back End of Line)
attributes.description: High-level semiconductor fabrication stage classification: FEOL (Front End of Line) covers transistor formation; MOL (Middle of Line) covers local interconnects; BEOL (Back End of Line) covers metal interconnect layers. Used for WIP stage-gate reporting and cycle time decomposition.

tag_set.value: Process Stage (Front End of Line / Middle of Line / Back End of Line)

attributes.name: route_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the process route assigned to this lot. Tracks which revision of the process flow was active at lot start, supporting process change impact analysis and PCN (Product Change Notification) traceability.

attributes.name: scrap_wafer_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of wafers scrapped from this lot since lot creation. Includes wafers scrapped due to process excursions, equipment failures, or quality dispositions. Used for yield loss analysis and DPPM (Defective Parts Per Million) reporting.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this wafer lot record was sourced (e.g., CAMSTAR for Camstar MES, SMARTFACTORY for Applied Materials SmartFactory, SAP_PP for SAP Production Planning). Supports data lineage and multi-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the wafer lot is expected to complete all FAB process steps and be ready for wafer probe/test. Derived from the process flow cycle time and lot start date. Used for delivery commitment and capacity planning.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer lot master record was last modified in the inventory data product. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the inventory valuation amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, TWD). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: The wafer count of the inventory wafer lot record in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: wafer_count_current
attributes.description: Current number of wafers remaining in the lot after accounting for any scrapped or split wafers during processing. Reflects real-time WIP inventory quantity for this lot.

attributes.name: wafer_count_start
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot at the time of lot creation (wafer start). Typically 25 wafers per FOUP/cassette for standard lots. Used as the baseline denominator for yield and scrap rate calculations. This is the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT / principal measured quantity for this WIP transaction.

attributes.name: wafer_diameter_mm
attributes.description: Physical diameter of the silicon wafers in this lot, in millimeters. Standard values are 200mm (8-inch) and 300mm (12-inch). Determines equipment compatibility, cassette type, and cost per wafer.

products.name: raw_material
products.description: Master record for raw materials consumed in semiconductor manufacturing including silicon wafers (bare and epitaxial), process chemicals, specialty gases, photomasks, CMP slurries, and ALD precursors. Captures material code, description, material class, unit of measure, supplier part number, shelf life, storage temperature range, hazard classification (RoHS/REACH), reorder point, and safety stock level. SSOT for raw material identity in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a raw material master record in the semiconductor inventory domain. Primary key for the raw_material product.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material master record within the raw material inventory entity.

attributes.name: quality_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Raw Material Quality Management designates an owner engineer for each material to ensure compliance with RoHS, REACH, and internal quality audits.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Raw materials need a default storage location for receiving and replenishment workflows.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: PROCUREMENT: Supplier of each raw material is required for qualification, lead‑time, and compliance tracking; experts expect a direct supplier_id FK.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The primary unit of measure in which the raw material is stocked and consumed (e.g., EA for each wafer, KG for chemicals, L for liquids, M2 for photomasks).
